  return '<text x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" text-anchor="' + (o.a || 'middle') + '" fill="' + fill + '" font-family="' + (o.f || F_JP) + '" font-weight="' + (o.w || 700) + '" font-size="' + sz + '"' + (o.ls ? ' letter-spacing="' + o.ls + '"' : '') + (o.op ? ' opacity="' + o.op + '"' : '') + (o.tr ? ' transform="' + o.tr + '"' : '') + '>' + t + '</text>';
}

/* ================================================================
   the reading room's little tools, copied so the two rooms grain the same way
   ================================================================ */
function hx(s){ return [parseInt(s.substr(1,2),16), parseInt(s.substr(3,2),16), parseInt(s.substr(5,2),16)]; }
function hsh(a,b){ var n = (Math.imul(a|0,374761393) + Math.imul(b|0,668265263))|0; n = Math.imul(n ^ (n>>>13), 1274126177); n = n ^ (n>>>16); return (n>>>0) / 4294967296; }
function vn(x,y){ var xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y), fx = x-xi, fy = y-yi; fx = fx*fx*(3-2*fx); fy = fy*fy*(3-2*fy); var a = hsh(xi,yi), b = hsh(xi+1,yi), c = hsh(xi,yi+1), d = hsh(xi+1,yi+1); return a + (b-a)*fx + (c-a)*fy + (a-b-c+d)*fx*fy; }
function fbm(x,y){ return vn(x,y)*0.55 + vn(x*2.03+17.1,y*2.03-9.4)*0.3 + vn(x*4.1-3.3,y*4.1+5.7)*0.15; }
function frac(v){ return v - Math.floor(v); }
function clamp(v,a,b){ return v < a ? a : (v > b ? b : v); }
function sm(a,b,v){ var t = clamp((v - a)/(b - a), 0, 1); return t*t*(3 - 2*t); }

/* ================================================================
   ramps. every material is a short ramp, same as the reading room — shading
   picks a step, bayer picks between steps. wood, paper, black, brass, rustm,

if (typeof F03 === 'undefined') (function(){
  function hx2(c){ return [parseInt(c.slice(1, 3), 16), parseInt(c.slice(3, 5), 16), parseInt(c.slice(5, 7), 16)]; }
  function mute(c, k){ var q = hx2(c), L = (q[0]*0.3 + q[1]*0.59 + q[2]*0.11)/255, d = [L*1.12 + 0.03, L*0.92, L*0.9];
    return '#' + q.map(function(v, i){ var o = Math.round(Math.max(0, Math.min(1, v/255*(1 - k) + d[i]*k))*255); return (o < 16 ? '0' : '') + o.toString(16); }).join(''); }
  RAMP_SRC.hglrose = RAMP_SRC.hglrose.map(function(c){ return mute(c, 0.72); });
  RAMP_SRC.tagmuted = RAMP_SRC.tagpink.map(function(c){ return mute(c, 0.55); });   /* (Oct 30, Aisling: her friend's tag "too bright … a muted orange") */
})();

/* depth fog, the reading room's: far things lose contrast and drift toward a
   dark plum. prebaked into a table (ramp × fog level × step) so the frame loop
   only ever looks colours up. */
var FOGN = 16, RMAX = 16, FOGMAX = 0.95, FOGC = [122, 103, 97];   /* Furusato: bright, so far things fade toward a pale warm grey, and less of them goes */
var RF = new Uint32Array(RNAMES.length*FOGN*RMAX);
RNAMES.forEach(function(k, ri){
  var cols = RAMP_SRC[k].map(hx), FOGC0 = FOGC;
  if (HUB_RAMPS[k]) FOGC = HUB_FOGC;   /* the hub's ramps fade to warm brown */
  if (STREET_RAMPS[k]) FOGC = STREET_FOGC;
  if (P2_RAMPS[k]) FOGC = P2_FOGC;   /* the street's, into its fog */
  for (var f = 0; f < FOGN; f++) {
    var fk = f/(FOGN - 1)*FOGMAX;
    for (var j = 0; j < RMAX; j++) {
      var c = cols[Math.min(j, cols.length - 1)];
      var r = c[0] + (FOGC[0] - c[0])*fk, g = c[1] + (FOGC[1] - c[1])*fk, b = c[2] + (FOGC[2] - c[2])*fk;
      RF[(ri*FOGN + f)*RMAX + j] = 0xff000000 | ((b|0) << 16) | ((g|0) << 8) | (r|0);
    }
  }
  FOGC = FOGC0;
});
var BAY = new Float32Array([0,8,2,10,12,4,14,6,3,11,1,9,15,7,13,5].map(function(v){ return (v + 0.5)/16; }));

/* one texel = ramp (6 bits) + value 0..1 (9 bits) + lit-from-inside flag (1 bit).
   same idea as the reading room's M/V/E buffers, just packed. */
/* Oct 5 (Aisling): the deir sign — its own character: a lowercase д with a bar through its middle,
   a little wider than the letter (like ₽). it's one glyph in a tiny font of its own ("Deir", at U+E0D0,
   drawn by font/mkdeir.py — redraw it there and paste the new base64 here to change the sign everywhere).
   in the code a price is still written д + U+0336; pictures, captions and Plt 1's printed close-ups turn
   that into the sign; the dot fonts have their own barred д (FONT['д']) */
var DEIR_CH = '\uE0D0', DEIR_SRC = 'url(data:font/ttf;base64,) format("truetype")';
var DEIR_CSS = '@font-face{font-family:Deir;src:' + DEIR_SRC + '}';
(function(){ try { var st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = DEIR_CSS; document.head.appendChild(st); var ff = new FontFace('Deir', DEIR_SRC); ff.load().then(function(f){ document.fonts.add(f); }); } catch (e) {} })();
function deirSvg(s){
  if (s.indexOf('д\u0336') < 0) return s;
  s = s.replace(/д\u0336/g, '<tspan font-family="Deir">' + DEIR_CH + '</tspan>');
  var k = s.indexOf('<svg'), e = k >= 0 ? s.indexOf('>', k) : -1;
  return e >= 0 ? s.slice(0, e + 1) + '<defs><style>' + DEIR_CSS + '</style></defs>' + s.slice(e + 1) : s;
}
var encodeURIComponent = (function(enc){ return function(s){ return enc(typeof s === 'string' && s.indexOf('<svg') >= 0 ? deirSvg(s) : s); }; })(window.encodeURIComponent);
function setTextDeir(el, t){
  t = t == null ? '' : String(t);
  if (t.indexOf('д\u0336') < 0) { el.textContent = t; return; }
  el.textContent = ''; var parts = t.split('д\u0336');
  parts.forEach(function(q, i){ if (q) el.appendChild(document.createTextNode(q)); if (i < parts.length - 1) { var sp = document.createElement('span'); sp.textContent = DEIR_CH; sp.style.fontFamily = 'Deir'; el.appendChild(sp); } });
}
function PK(ri, v, e){ return (ri << 10) | (Math.round(clamp(v,0,1)*511) << 1) | (e ? 1 : 0); }

var BOX_CLEAR = (RIX.sfog << 10) | 1;   /* sfog, value 0, "lit": nothing paints this, so a hub box texel with it is see-through */

/* ================================================================
   textures. painted once at load from functions of world position — same as
   the reading room builds its room from depth instead of fixed shapes.
   128 texels per world unit, so a wall cell is 128 wide and 256 tall.
   each texture keeps smaller copies (mipmaps) for far away, or distant walls
   would sparkle as I walk. picked per column / per row by distance.
   ================================================================ */
var TEXRES = 128;
function newTex(w, h){ return { scale:1, lv:[{ w:w, h:h, d:new Uint16Array(w*h) }] }; }
/* shrinking a texture: average how bright the four texels actually look, keep the
   material most of them are, and find that brightness in its ramp. the first
   version averaged the raw values and kept the joint's near-black ramp on a tie,
   so every slab joint stayed pitch black at every distance and broke into dashes. */
var RLUM = RNAMES.map(function(k){ return RAMP_SRC[k].map(function(c){ var q = hx(c); return q[0]*0.3 + q[1]*0.59 + q[2]*0.11; }); });
function lumOf(ri, v){ var L = RLUM[ri], p = v*(L.length - 1), i = Math.floor(p); if (i >= L.length - 1) return L[L.length - 1]; return L[i] + (L[i + 1] - L[i])*(p - i); }
function vFor(ri, lum){
  var L = RLUM[ri], n = L.length;
  if (lum <= L[0]) return 0; if (lum >= L[n - 1]) return 1;
  for (var i = 0; i < n - 1; i++) if (lum <= L[i + 1]) return (i + (lum - L[i])/Math.max(1e-6, L[i + 1] - L[i]))/(n - 1);
  return 1;
}
function mix4(a,b,c,d){
  var q = [a, b, c, d], lum = 0, e = 0, best = -1, r = a >> 10, bestL = -1;
  for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
    var rk = q[k] >> 10, lk = lumOf(rk, ((q[k] >> 1) & 511)/511);
    lum += lk; e += q[k] & 1;
    var cnt = 0; for (var m = 0; m < 4; m++) if ((q[m] >> 10) === rk) cnt++;
    if (cnt > best || (cnt === best && lk > bestL)) { best = cnt; r = rk; bestL = lk; }
  }
  /* a lone glitter fleck (lit silver or gold) survives into the smaller copy, so the floor still sparkles further off */
  var gm = -1; for (var g1 = 0; g1 < 4; g1++) if ((q[g1] & 1) && (q[g1] >> 10) === RIX.granite) gm = g1;
  if (gm >= 0) { var gv0 = Math.round(vFor(r, lum/4)*511); return (r << 10) | (gv0 << 1) | (gm === 0 ? 1 : 0); }   /* glitter marks thin out in smaller copies so there are never more of them further away (it was a disco floor) */
  if (e === 1) for (var g2 = 0; g2 < 4; g2++) { var gq = q[g2]; if ((gq & 1) && ((gq >> 10) === RIX.silver || (gq >> 10) === RIX.gold) && ((gq >> 1) & 511) > 460) return (gq & 0xFC01) | (Math.round(((gq >> 1) & 511)*0.9) << 1); }
  var v = Math.round(vFor(r, lum/4)*511);
  return (r << 10) | (v << 1) | (e >= 2 ? 1 : 0);
}
function buildMips(t){
  var want = t.scale > 1 ? 7 : 6;
  while (t.lv.length < want) {
    var s = t.lv[t.lv.length - 1], w = s.w >> 1, h = s.h >> 1, d = new Uint16Array(w*h);
    for (var y = 0; y < h; y++) for (var x = 0; x < w; x++) {
      var i = (y*2)*s.w + x*2;
      d[y*w + x] = mix4(s.d[i], s.d[i + 1], s.d[i + s.w], s.d[i + s.w + 1]);
    }
    t.lv.push({ w:w, h:h, d:d });
  }
  return t;
}

/* wall faces. face 0 = west side of the cell, 1 = east, 2 = north, 3 = south.
   u runs left to right as I see the face, so writing on a wall reads the right
   way round from any side. the painter gets u, the height h (0 floor, 2 top),
   and the world point (x, y) the texel sits on. */
/* (Oct 31) a wall picture's rows: its height in texels is rounded to 64, so a texel row was a hair shorter than a
   texel column (1216 rows for 2.4 at 512), and a grid of small tiles didn't land on whole texels: some grout lines
   came out thicker than others. with WALL_SNAP on (Furusato), rows are exactly as tall as columns are wide, and the
   picture is stretched the hair (about 1%) to fill the wall. off: as it always was */
var WALL_SNAP = false;
function wallRowH(j, Lh, WH, res){ if (WALL_SNAP) { var Hs = Lh/res; if (Math.abs(Hs - WH) < 0.03*WH) return (Lh - j - 0.5)/res; } return WH*(1 - (j + 0.5)/Lh); }
function paintWall(cx, cy, face, fn, res, hgt){
  res = res || TEXRES; TI_RES = res;
  /* height follows the wall (2.4 since the room got taller), rounded to 64.
     hub build: a wall can be taller than Plt 1's (the hall's walls rise into the vault) —
     hgt, or the room's own wall height; t.hgt tells the frame how tall the picture is */
  var WH = hgt || wallHFor(cx, cy, face);
  var t = newTex(res, Math.round(res*WH/64)*64), L = t.lv[0]; t.scale = res/TEXRES; t.hgt = WH;
  for (var j = 0; j < L.h; j++) {
    var h = wallRowH(j, L.h, WH, res);
    for (var i = 0; i < L.w; i++) {
      var u = (i + 0.5)/L.w, x, y;
      if (face === 0) { x = cx; y = cy + u; }
      else if (face === 1) { x = cx + 1; y = cy + 1 - u; }
      else if (face === 2) { x = cx + 1 - u; y = cy; }
      else { x = cx + u; y = cy + 1; }
      L.d[j*L.w + i] = fn(u, h, x, y, i, j);
    }
  }
  TI_RES = TEXRES;
  return buildMips(t);
}
/* floors and ceilings are painted straight in world x/y, so patterns run on
   across cells without seams */
/* direct = paint every smaller copy from scratch instead of averaging down.
   the mosaics need it: averaged grout turns a far panel into plaid, so the far
   copies are painted with no grout at all (PAINT_LOD tells the painter which copy). */
var PAINT_LOD = 0;
/* res = texels per unit. the mosaics use 256 (twice everything else) so the tesserae
   hold up when I'm standing right under a panel looking up. */
function paintFlat(cx, cy, fn, direct, res){
  res = res || TEXRES;
  var t = newTex(res, res); t.scale = res/TEXRES;
  for (var l = 0; l < (direct ? 7 : 1); l++) {
    if (l > 0) t.lv.push({ w:res >> l, h:res >> l, d:new Uint16Array((res >> l)*(res >> l)) });
    var L = t.lv[l]; PAINT_LOD = l; TI_RES = res >> l;
    for (var j = 0; j < L.h; j++) for (var i = 0; i < L.w; i++) {
      L.d[j*L.w + i] = fn(cx + (i + 0.5)/L.w, cy + (j + 0.5)/L.h, i, j);
    }
  }
  PAINT_LOD = 0; TI_RES = TEXRES;
  return direct ? t : buildMips(t);
}

/* is the point (s, h) inside a lit pixel of this string?
   s runs right, h runs up; s0 is the left edge, top is the top of the line, px is one font pixel in world units */
function textHit(str, s, h, s0, top, px){
  var gx = (s - s0)/px, gy = (top - h)/px;
  if (gy < 0 || gy >= 7 || gx < 0) return false;
  var ci = Math.floor(gx/6), col = Math.floor(gx - ci*6);
  if (ci >= str.length || col >= 5) return false;
  var g = FONT[str.charAt(ci)];
  return !!g && g[Math.floor(gy)].charAt(col) === '#';
}
function textW(str, px){ return (str.length*6 - 1)*px; }

/* the reading room's fake print: word-shaped dashes that read as text from a
   step back without saying anything. for poster small print and labels. */
function scribble(s, h, s0, s1, top, lineH, lines, seed){
  if (s < s0 || s > s1 || h > top || h < top - lines*lineH) return false;
  var line = Math.floor((top - h)/lineH), fy = ((top - h)/lineH) - line;
  if (fy < 0.25 || fy > 0.72) return false;
  var k = Math.floor((s - s0)/(lineH*0.9)), wk = hsh(k + line*31, seed);
  if (wk < 0.2) return false;
  if (line === lines - 1 && (s - s0)/(s1 - s0) > 0.55) return false;
  return hsh(Math.floor((s - s0)/(lineH*0.22)), line + seed*7) > 0.22;
}

/* ================================================================
   GOING BETWEEN THE STATION'S PAGES (Oct 23, 2026; doc 30). shared by every station page
   (this one file is included by the station page and by Furusato's page as it is).
   - the pocket, passport, stamps and everything else live in the browser's storage
     ("nullgrey.*"). when both pages come from the same site address, that storage is
     shared and nothing else is needed.
   - as a backup, going between pages also carries those things in the link. the next
     page uses them only if its storage turns out not to be the same one (e.g. Safari
     with two local files).
   - inside Framer (an embed), the page asks the site to go to the other page's address;
     where you arrive is remembered in storage ("nullgrey.arrive").
   - the jump is hidden: a moment of dark and fog while the next page opens.
   runs first thing, before anything reads the storage.
   ================================================================ */
var NG_PAGES = {
  hub:      { path:'/between',  file:'null-grey-between-station.html' },
  furusato: { path:'/furusato', file:'furusato.html' },
  f03:      { path:'/mainstreet', file:'mainstreet.html' },   /* (Oct 25) F 03 · 本町 Main Street, Missing Mile: its little station */
  stop:     { path:'/stop', file:'stop.html' }   /* (Oct 31) a stand-in stop: where a ride ends until that stop is built (Embroidery). the stop is in the arrival code */
};
var NGJ = { leaving:false, fade:null };
function ngArrival(here){
  var q = null, A = null;
  try { q = new URLSearchParams(location.search); } catch (e) {}
  try { A = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nullgrey.arrive') || 'null'); } catch (e) {}
  var tok = q && q.get('tok');
  if (tok) {
    if (!(A && A.tok === tok)) {   /* this page's storage isn't the one the last page wrote to: take what came in the link */
      try { var c = JSON.parse(decodeURIComponent(escape(atob(q.get('carry') || '')))); for (var k in c) if (k.indexOf('nullgrey.') === 0 && k !== 'nullgrey.arrive') localStorage.setItem(k, c[k]); } catch (e) {}
    }
    try { localStorage.removeItem('nullgrey.arrive'); history.replaceState(null, '', location.pathname); } catch (e) {}
    return q.get('arrive') ? { at:q.get('arrive') } : null;
  }
  if (A && A.to === here && Date.now() - A.t < 180000) { try { localStorage.removeItem('nullgrey.arrive'); } catch (e) {} return { at:A.at }; }
  return null;
}
function ngCarry(){
  var c = {};
  try { for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) { var k = localStorage.key(i); if (k && k.indexOf('nullgrey.') === 0 && k !== 'nullgrey.arrive') c[k] = localStorage.getItem(k); } } catch (e) {}
  try { return btoa(unescape(encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify(c)))); } catch (e) { return ''; }
}
/* the dark and the fog over the jump */
function ngFade(on){
  if (!NGJ.fade) {
    var st = document.createElement('style');
    st.textContent = '#ng-fade{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;transition:opacity .7s ease;z-index:45;' +

/* go to another station page: the fade, then the next page */
function ngGoTo(page, at){
  if (NGJ.leaving) return; NGJ.leaving = true;
  ngFade(true);
  setTimeout(function(){
    var P = NG_PAGES[page], tok = String(Date.now()) + Math.floor(Math.random()*1e6);
    try { localStorage.setItem('nullgrey.arrive', JSON.stringify({ to:page, at:at, tok:tok, t:Date.now() })); } catch (e) {}
    if (window.parent && window.parent !== window) { try { window.parent.postMessage({ nullgrey:'navigate', href:P.path }, '*'); } catch (e) {} return; }   /* inside Framer: the site moves */
    location.href = P.file + '?arrive=' + encodeURIComponent(at) + '&tok=' + tok + '&carry=' + encodeURIComponent(ngCarry());
  }, 750);
}

function wallHFor(cx, cy, face){
  var nx = cx + (face === 0 ? -1 : face === 1 ? 1 : 0), ny = cy + (face === 2 ? -1 : face === 3 ? 1 : 0);
  if (nx >= 0 && ny >= 0 && nx < MW && ny < MH && !isWall(cellAt(nx, ny))) return CEILK[ny*MW + nx];
  return WALL_H;
}

/* ================================================================
   STEP 8 — THE POCKET: the things in it (doc 20).
   each thing is drawn once as an svg, then at load turned into station
   pixels (every pixel snapped into the station's own colour ramps and
   dithered), the same way the posters are. that's what lets it lie crooked
   and small in the pocket and lift up big and straight without blurring.
   vb: the drawing's size; k: pixels per unit when it's lifted to the
   middle; lie: how big it lies in the pocket (of the lifted size).
   Aisling can rewrite any caption here.
   ================================================================ */
var PKC = { cream:'#e4dcd0', card:'#e8dcc4', paper:'#ddd3c0', void:'#0a0908', rust:'#8a5240', red:'#9a2a22', plum:'#5c4a63', dplum:'#241b29', grey:'#8c8983', amber:'#d9a441', gold:'#c9a86a', silver:'#d8d6d0' };
function pkT(t, x, y, sz, fill, o){ o = o || {}; return '<text x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '"' + (o.anchor ? ' text-anchor="' + o.anchor + '"' : ' text-anchor="middle"') + (o.tf ? ' transform="' + o.tf + '"' : '') + ' style="fill:' + fill + ';font-family:' + (o.font || 'monospace') + ';font-size:' + sz + 'px;font-weight:' + (o.w || 400) + ';letter-spacing:' + (o.ls || 0) + 'px' + (o.it ? ';font-style:italic' : '') + '">' + t + '</text>'; }
/* the size a line of text needs to fit maxW, measured in this browser's own font (Aisling, Oct 2:
   the newspaper's changing lines ran off the page — fonts differ between machines) */
function pkFit(t, sz, maxW, o){
  o = o || {};
  try {
    var c = pkFit.c || (pkFit.c = document.createElement('canvas').getContext('2d'));
    c.font = (o.it ? 'italic ' : '') + (o.w || 400) + ' ' + sz + 'px ' + (o.font || 'monospace');
    var w = c.measureText(t).width + (o.ls || 0)*t.length;
    return w > maxW ? Math.floor(sz*maxW/w*10)/10 : sz;
  } catch (e) { return sz; }
}
function pkWrap(s, n){ var w = s.split(' '), out = [], cur = ''; w.forEach(function(x){ if ((cur + ' ' + x).trim().length > n) { out.push(cur.trim()); cur = x; } else cur += ' ' + x; }); if (cur.trim()) out.push(cur.trim()); return out; }
function pkStar(x, y, r, fill){ return '<path d="M' + x + ' ' + (y - r) + ' L' + (x + r*0.28) + ' ' + (y - r*0.28) + ' L' + (x + r) + ' ' + y + ' L' + (x + r*0.28) + ' ' + (y + r*0.28) + ' L' + x + ' ' + (y + r) + ' L' + (x - r*0.28) + ' ' + (y + r*0.28) + ' L' + (x - r) + ' ' + y + ' L' + (x - r*0.28) + ' ' + (y - r*0.28) + 'Z" fill="' + fill + '"/>'; }

function pkHolo(id){ return '<linearGradient id="' + id + '" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="0" y1="0" x2="120" y2="60" spreadMethod="reflect"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#b9b7b2"/><stop offset="0.25" stop-color="#9c8fb8"/><stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#a8a6a0"/><stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#c9a86a"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#b9b7b2"/></linearGradient>'; }
function pkRuneRow(x, y, n, grad, seed, vertical, sw){ var d = '', r = seed; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { r = (r*9301 + 49297) % 233280; var f = PK_RUNES[r % PK_RUNES.length]; d += vertical ? f(x, y - i*16) + ' ' : f(x + i*9, y) + ' '; } return '<path d="' + d + '" fill="none" stroke="url(#' + grad + ')" stroke-width="' + (sw || 1.3) + '" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>'; }
function pkStar5(x, y, r, fill){ var d = ''; for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) { var a = -Math.PI/2 + i*Math.PI/5, rr = i % 2 ? r*0.45 : r; d += (i ? 'L' : 'M') + (x + Math.cos(a)*rr).toFixed(2) + ' ' + (y + Math.sin(a)*rr).toFixed(2); } return '<path d="' + d + 'Z" fill="' + fill + '"/>'; }

/* ---- the rest: small extra details ---- */
/* a snowflake drawn by a ministry: six arms (the regulation says six), each
   tipped with a little star, a red five-point star at the heart that doesn't
   fit the count, and one arm with a branch too many */
function pkSovietFlake(cx, cy, r, col, heart){
  var s = '<g stroke="' + col + '" stroke-width="' + (r*0.09) + '" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none">';
  for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
    var a = -Math.PI/2 + i*Math.PI/3, ca = Math.cos(a), sa = Math.sin(a), ex = cx + ca*r*0.78, ey = cy + sa*r*0.78;
    s += '<line x1="' + (cx + ca*r*0.24).toFixed(2) + '" y1="' + (cy + sa*r*0.24).toFixed(2) + '" x2="' + ex.toFixed(2) + '" y2="' + ey.toFixed(2) + '"/>';
    var nb = i === 4 ? 3 : 2;   /* the wrong arm */
    for (var b = 0; b < nb; b++) {
      var t = 0.42 + b*0.17, bx = cx + ca*r*t, by = cy + sa*r*t, l = r*(0.22 - b*0.04);

/* ---- colours: snapping a drawing into the station's ramps ---- */
var PK_INKS = (function(){
  var list = [];
  ['paper', 'black', 'silver', 'metal', 'brass', 'gold', 'rustm', 'bRust', 'bPlum', 'plumglow', 'wood', 'amber', 'granR'].forEach(function(nm){
    var ri = RIX[nm]; if (ri === undefined) return;
    var n = RN[ri]; for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var c = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + k]; list.push([ri, (k + 0.5)/n, c & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, (c >> 16) & 255]); }   /* the colours as they actually come out on screen */
  });
  return list;
})();
/* step 11: the hub's olive green too, but only for things that are green (ALIEN WAVE read grey) */
var PK_INKS_G = PK_INKS.concat((function(){ var l = [], ri = RIX.holive; if (ri === undefined) return l; var n = RN[ri]; for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var c = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + k]; l.push([ri, (k + 0.5)/n, c & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, (c >> 16) & 255]); } return l; })());
/* (Oct 13) loud things (the 1995 coupon) keep loud colours: the Japan tunnel's vivid green and neon gold, plum, rust, white and black. never blue */
var PK_INKS_L = PK_INKS_G.concat((function(){ var l = []; ['pgreen', 'pneon', 'pwhite', 'bPlum', 'bRust'].forEach(function(nm){ var ri = RIX[nm]; if (ri === undefined) return; var n = RN[ri]; for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var c = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + k]; l.push([ri, (k + 0.5)/n, c & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, (c >> 16) & 255]); } }); return l; })());
var PK_INKCL = {};
function pkInkL(r, g, b){
  var key = (r >> 2) << 12 | (g >> 2) << 6 | (b >> 2), c = PK_INKCL[key]; if (c) return c;
  var best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (var k = 0; k < PK_INKS_L.length; k++) { var q = PK_INKS_L[k], dr = r - q[2], dg = g - q[3], db = b - q[4], d = dr*dr*0.3 + dg*dg*0.59 + db*db*0.11; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } }
  PK_INKCL[key] = best; return best;
}
var PK_INKC = {}, PK_INKCG = {};
function pkInkG(r, g, b){
  var key = (r >> 2) << 12 | (g >> 2) << 6 | (b >> 2), c = PK_INKCG[key]; if (c) return c;
  var best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (var k = 0; k < PK_INKS_G.length; k++) { var q = PK_INKS_G[k], dr = r - q[2], dg = g - q[3], db = b - q[4], d = dr*dr*0.3 + dg*dg*0.59 + db*db*0.11; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } }
  PK_INKCG[key] = best; return best;
}
function pkInk(r, g, b){
  var key = (r >> 2) << 12 | (g >> 2) << 6 | (b >> 2), c = PK_INKC[key]; if (c) return c;
  var best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (var k = 0; k < PK_INKS.length; k++) { var q = PK_INKS[k], dr = r - q[2], dg = g - q[3], db = b - q[4], d = dr*dr*0.3 + dg*dg*0.59 + db*db*0.11; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } }
  PK_INKC[key] = best; return best;
}
/* an svg turned into a map of (ramp, value) at its lifted size */
function pkMap(id, done){
  var A = PK_ART[id], w = Math.round(A.vb[0]*A.k), h = Math.round(A.vb[1]*A.k), img = new Image();
  img.onload = function(){
    var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
    var x = c.getContext('2d'); x.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; x.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'; x.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
    var d = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h).data, RI = new Int16Array(w*h), V = new Float32Array(w*h);
    var ink = A.ink || (A.loud ? pkInkL : (A.green ? pkInkG : pkInk));   /* (Oct 14) a thing can bring its own inks (the red paper unicorn) */
    for (var i = 0; i < w*h; i++) { if (d[i*4 + 3] < 120) { RI[i] = -1; continue; } var q = ink(d[i*4], d[i*4 + 1], d[i*4 + 2]); RI[i] = q[0]; V[i] = q[1]; }
    POK.maps[id] = { w:w, h:h, RI:RI, V:V }; done();
  };
  img.onerror = function(){ done(); };
  img.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ' + A.vb[0] + ' ' + A.vb[1] + '" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '">' + A.svg() + '</svg>');
}
/* draw one thing: scale (of its lifted size), turn (radians), light (0..1+).
   returns a canvas, where its middle is, and a mask for clicking */
function pkSprite(id, sc, rot, light, now){
  var M = POK.maps[id], A = PK_ART[id]; if (!M) return null;
  var cs = Math.cos(rot), sn = Math.sin(rot), hw = M.w*sc/2, hh = M.h*sc/2;
  var W = Math.ceil(Math.abs(hw*cs) + Math.abs(hh*sn))*2 + 2, H = Math.ceil(Math.abs(hw*sn) + Math.abs(hh*cs))*2 + 2;
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = H;
  var x = c.getContext('2d'), id2 = x.createImageData(W, H), d = new Uint32Array(id2.data.buffer), mask = new Uint8Array(W*H);
  var ss = sc < 0.7, foil = A.foil && now, ft = now ? now/1000 : 0, inv = 1/sc;
  for (var j = 0; j < H; j++) for (var i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    var ri = -1, v = 0, n = 0, offs = ss ? [[-0.25, -0.25], [0.25, -0.25], [-0.25, 0.25], [0.25, 0.25]] : [[0, 0]];
    for (var o = 0; o < offs.length; o++) {
      var dx = i + 0.5 + offs[o][0] - W/2, dy = j + 0.5 + offs[o][1] - H/2;
      var mx = (dx*cs + dy*sn)*inv + M.w/2, my = (-dx*sn + dy*cs)*inv + M.h/2;
      if (mx < 0 || my < 0 || mx >= M.w || my >= M.h) continue;
      var k = (my | 0)*M.w + (mx | 0), r = M.RI[k]; if (r < 0) continue;
      if (ri < 0) ri = r; v += M.V[k]; n++;
      if (foil && o === 0 && (r === R_SILVER || r === R_GOLD || r === R_PLUMGLOW)) v += 0.32*Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(frac(mx/M.w*0.8 + my/M.h*0.5 - ft*0.22) - 0.5)*9);   /* the foil catches the light as it moves */
    }
    if (ri < 0 || n < offs.length/2) continue;
    v = v/n*light; var nR = RN[ri], b = BAY[((j & 3) << 2) | (i & 3)], idx = (v*(nR - 1) + b) | 0; if (idx >= nR) idx = nR - 1; if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
    d[j*W + i] = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + idx]; mask[j*W + i] = 1;
  }
  x.putImageData(id2, 0, 0);
  return { c:c, W:W, H:H, mask:mask };
}
function pkShadow(S){
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = S.W + 4; c.height = S.H + 4;
  var x = c.getContext('2d'), id = x.createImageData(c.width, c.height), d = id.data;
  for (var j = 0; j < c.height; j++) for (var i = 0; i < c.width; i++) {
    var on = 0; for (var dj = -2; dj <= 0 && !on; dj++) for (var di = -2; di <= 0; di++) { var si = i + di, sj = j + dj; if (si >= 0 && sj >= 0 && si < S.W && sj < S.H && S.mask[sj*S.W + si]) { on = 1; break; } }
    if (on) { var k = (j*c.width + i)*4; d[k] = 4; d[k + 1] = 3; d[k + 2] = 5; d[k + 3] = 255; }
  }
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); return c;
}
/* text cut out as hard pixels (for the code in the seam, and code names) */
function pkTextSprite(lines, px, col, lh){
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'), x = c.getContext('2d'); x.font = px + 'px monospace';
  var w = 0; lines.forEach(function(l){ w = Math.max(w, Math.ceil(x.measureText(l).width)); });
  c.width = w + 2; c.height = lines.length*lh + 2; x = c.getContext('2d'); x.font = px + 'px monospace'; x.fillStyle = col; x.textBaseline = 'top';
  lines.forEach(function(l, i){ x.fillText(l, 1, 1 + i*lh); });
  var id = x.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height), d = id.data; for (var k = 3; k < d.length; k += 4) d[k] = d[k] > 110 ? 255 : 0;
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); return c;
}

/* ---- the pocket itself: wool, the lip, the rings going down, the frame ---- */
function pkInside(x, y){ if (x < 64 || x > 704 || y < 78) return false; if (y < 276) return true; var ex = (x - 384)/320, ey = (y - 266)/100; return ex*ex + ey*ey <= 1; }
function pkEdge(x, y){ if (pkInside(x - 8, y) && pkInside(x + 8, y) && pkInside(x, y - 8) && pkInside(x, y + 8) && pkInside(x - 6, y + 6) && pkInside(x + 6, y + 6)) return 99; var e = 99; for (var a = 0; a < 16; a++) { var an = a/16*Math.PI*2, xx = x + Math.cos(an)*7, yy = y + Math.sin(an)*7; if (!pkInside(xx, yy)) { var dd = 7; for (var r = 1; r < 7; r++) if (!pkInside(x + Math.cos(an)*r, y + Math.sin(an)*r)) { dd = r; break; } e = Math.min(e, dd); } } return e; }
var PK_GLYPHS = 'ДОМЖЯФЭЮЩЛИКУРХБウキヨポケットイマスラナᚠᚢᚦᚨᚱᚲᚷᚹᚺᚾᛁᛃᛇᛈᛉᛊᛏᛒᛖᛗᛚᛜᛞᛟ';
function pkBand(n){ var s = ''; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var t = Math.random(); s += t < 0.62 ? PK_GLYPHS[(Math.random()*PK_GLYPHS.length) | 0] : (Math.random() < 0.5 ? '0' : '1'); if (Math.random() < 0.1) s += '·'; } return s; }
function pkSeal(x, y){ return '<g transform="translate(' + x + ',' + y + ')"><circle r="12" fill="#0a0908" stroke="#8a5240" stroke-width="1.6"/><circle cx="-4.2" cy="2.2" r="2.8" fill="none" stroke="#e4dcd0" stroke-width="1"/><circle cx="4.2" cy="2.2" r="2.8" fill="none" stroke="#e4dcd0" stroke-width="1"/><circle cx="0" cy="-4.2" r="2.8" fill="none" stroke="#e4dcd0" stroke-width="1"/><circle cx="0" cy="-9" r="1" fill="#d9a441"/><circle cx="-8" cy="5.4" r="1" fill="#d9a441"/><circle cx="8" cy="5.4" r="1" fill="#d9a441"/></g>'; }

function pkBuildBg(done){
  var img = new Image();
  img.onload = function(){
    var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = PW; c.height = PH;
    var x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0, PW, PH);
    var sv = x.getImageData(0, 0, PW, PH).data, id = x.createImageData(PW, PH), d = new Uint32Array(id.data.buffer);
    for (var j = 0; j < PH; j++) for (var i = 0; i < PW; i++) {
      var k = j*PW + i, ri, v;
      if (sv[k*4 + 3] > 128) { var q = pkInk(sv[k*4], sv[k*4 + 1], sv[k*4 + 2]); ri = q[0]; v = q[1]; }
      else if (j >= 70 && j < 92 && i > 52 && i < 716) {   /* the lip: a fold of wool along the top, stitched */
        ri = R_BPLUM; var lt = (j - 70)/22; v = 0.2 + 0.1*Math.sin(lt*Math.PI) - (lt > 0.85 ? 0.12 : 0) + (lt < 0.1 ? 0.08 : 0);
        v += (frac((i + j)*0.34) < 0.5 ? 0.025 : -0.01) + (hsh(i, j + 3) - 0.5)*0.05;
        if (Math.abs(j - 84) < 1 && frac(i/9) < 0.55) { ri = R_SILVER; v = 0.36; }
      } else if (pkInside(i, j)) {   /* the wool inside, darker the further down it goes */
        ri = R_BPLUM;
        var dd;
        var ex = (i - 384)/330, ey = (j - 292)/112; dd = Math.sqrt(ex*ex + ey*ey);
        v = 0.105 + (frac((i*0.5 + j*0.5)/2.6) < 0.5 ? 0.028 : 0) + (hsh(i + 17, j) - 0.5)*0.06 + (vn(i*0.05, j*0.07) - 0.5)*0.06 + (vn(i*0.6, j*0.25) - 0.5)*0.03;
        v *= 0.12 + 0.88*Math.pow(Math.min(1, dd), 0.9);
        [0.8, 0.58, 0.38, 0.2].forEach(function(r, n){ var q = Math.abs(dd - r); if (q < 0.018) v += (0.05 - n*0.007)*(1 - q/0.018); });
        var e = pkEdge(i, j); if (e < 7) v *= 0.55 + 0.45*e/7;
        if (e > 8.5 && e < 10 && j > 92 && frac((i + j*0.3)/8) < 0.5 && Math.abs(dd - 0.9) > 0.02) { ri = R_PLUMGLOW; v = 0.18; }   /* the dashed seam inside */
      } else { ri = R_BLACK; v = (i > 31 && i < 737 && j > 31 && j < 401) ? 0.07 + (hsh(i, j + 9) - 0.5)*0.03 : 0.035; }
      var nR = RN[ri], b = BAY[((j & 3) << 2) | (i & 3)], ix = (Math.max(0, v)*(nR - 1) + b) | 0; if (ix >= nR) ix = nR - 1;
      d[k] = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + ix];
    }
    x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); POK.bg = c; done();
  };
  img.onerror = function(){ done(); };
  img.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ' + PW + ' ' + PH + '" width="' + PW + '" height="' + PH + '">' + pkFrameSvg() + '</svg>');
}

/* ---- where things lie: the front first, then further down ---- */
var PK_SLOTS = [
  [170, 172, -0.16, 0], [332, 150, 0.1, 0], [505, 162, 0.2, 0], [626, 150, -0.07, 0], [214, 286, -0.24, 0], [614, 274, 0.14, 0],
  [300, 248, 0.08, 1], [462, 246, -0.17, 1], [392, 196, 0.05, 1], [540, 300, 0.12, 1], [596, 318, 0.3, 1],
  [330, 306, -0.1, 2], [446, 310, 0.15, 2], [262, 326, 0.07, 2], [512, 330, -0.13, 2], [384, 286, 0.2, 2]
];
var PK_DEPTH = [[1, 0.9], [0.8, 0.72], [0.64, 0.52], [0.5, 0.36]];
function pkList(){
  var L = KASSA.pass ? ['passport', 'multipass'] : [], got = PK_HAVE.filter(function(id){ return !!PK_ART[id]; }).reverse();   /* newest on top: older things sink */
  if (PASS_STATE === 2) got.unshift('pass');
  L = L.concat(got);
  L.push('note', 'lint');
  return L;
}
/* pages (Aisling): twelve things a layer; past that the pocket goes deeper.
   the Kodama ticket is always at the very bottom of the last layer */
var PK_PER = 12;
function pkPages(){ return Math.max(1, Math.ceil(pkList().length/PK_PER)); }
function pkLayout(){
  var L = pkList(), out = [], pages = Math.max(1, Math.ceil(L.length/PK_PER));
  POK.page = Math.min(POK.page || 0, pages - 1); POK.pages = pages;
  L.slice(POK.page*PK_PER, (POK.page + 1)*PK_PER).forEach(function(id, n){
    var s = PK_SLOTS[n], j = POK.page*7;   /* each layer lies a little differently */
    out.push({ id:id, x:s[0] + (hsh(n + j, 21) - 0.5)*(j ? 26 : 0), y:s[1] + (hsh(n + j, 22) - 0.5)*(j ? 14 : 0), rot:s[2] + (j ? (hsh(n + j, 23) - 0.5)*0.4 : 0), depth:s[3], n:n });
  });
  if (POK.page === pages - 1) out.push({ id:'kodama', x:384, y:336, rot:-0.07, depth:3, deep:true, n:99 });
  out.sort(function(a, b){ return b.depth - a.depth || a.n - b.n; });   /* deeper drawn first */
  out.forEach(function(it){
    var D = PK_DEPTH[it.depth], A = PK_ART[it.id];
    it.sc = A.lie*D[0]; it.light = (it.deep ? 0.32 : D[1])*(1 - 0.08*Math.min(3, POK.page || 0));
    it.S = pkSprite(it.id, it.sc, it.rot, it.light); it.sh = it.S ? pkShadow(it.S) : null;
    it.Sh = null;   /* the hover version, made when needed */
  });
  POK.items = out;
  pkNav();
}

}

/* ---- building it (the first time it's opened, or quietly after load) ---- */

  if (POK.building) { POK.after = done; return; }

}

function pkPos(e){ var r = pkCv.getBoundingClientRect(), s = Math.min(r.width/PW, r.height/PH), ox = r.left + (r.width - PW*s)/2, oy = r.top + (r.height - PH*s)/2; return [(e.clientX - ox)/s, (e.clientY - oy)/s]; }
function pkHit(p){
  if (POK.turn) return -1;
  for (var n = POK.items.length - 1; n >= 0; n--) {
    var it = POK.items[n], S = it.S; if (!S) continue;
    var i = Math.floor(p[0] - (it.x - S.W/2)), j = Math.floor(p[1] - (it.y + pkFloat(it) - S.H/2));
    if (i >= 0 && j >= 0 && i < S.W && j < S.H && S.mask[j*S.W + i]) return n;
  }
  return -1;
}

  if (POK.lift) { if (!POK.ask && POK.lift.t1 < 0 && POK.lift.done) pkPutBack(); return; }
  var h = pkHit(pkPos(e)); if (h < 0) return;
  var it = POK.items[h];
  if (it.deep) { setTextDeir(pkCap, PK_ART[it.id].cap); return; }
  pkLift(it);
});
window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if (e.target && e.target.tagName === 'INPUT') return;
  var k = (e.key || '').toLowerCase();
  if (POK.open) {
    e.stopImmediatePropagation();
    if (!POK.lift && (k === 'arrowdown' || k === 'pagedown' || k === 's')) { e.preventDefault(); pkTurn(1); return; }
    if (!POK.lift && (k === 'arrowup' || k === 'pageup' || k === 'w')) { e.preventDefault(); pkTurn(-1); return; }
    if (k === 'escape' || k === 'p' || k === 'backspace') { e.preventDefault(); if (POK.lift && !POK.ask) pkPutBack(); else if (!POK.lift) pkClose(); }
    return;
  }
  if (k === 'p' && !e.repeat && !CU.open && !LOOK.open && FIGTALK.i < 0) { e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); pkOpen(); }
}, true);

/* ---- lifting, putting back, using ---- */

  POK.lift = { it:it, t0:performance.now(), t1:-1, done:false }; if (PK_ART[it.id] && PK_ART[it.id].onLift) PK_ART[it.id].onLift(POK.lift);
  pkCap.textContent = '';

}
function pkPutBack(msg){
  if (!POK.lift) return;
  POK.lift.t1 = performance.now(); POK.lift.msg = msg;
  pkAsk.style.display = 'none'; POK.ask = null;
}

});
function pkFloat(it){   /* the 2002 quarter, now and then, floats up instead of settling */
  if (it.id !== 'quarter') return 0;
  var t = performance.now()/1000, c = frac(t/23);
  return c > 0.8 ? -Math.sin((c - 0.8)/0.2*Math.PI)*9 : 0;
}

/* ---- every frame while it's open ---- */
var PK_CODE = null;
function pkFrame(now){
  var x = pkCx; x.imageSmoothingEnabled = false;
  if (!POK.ready) { x.fillStyle = '#060505'; x.fillRect(0, 0, PW, PH); return; }
  x.drawImage(POK.bg, 0, 0);
  var L = POK.lift, liftIt = L ? L.it : null;
  /* the seam in the border: code through the gap, glitching every few seconds */
  if (!PK_CODE) PK_CODE = pkTextSprite(['0x7Я leak( 1022 4235 23333 ); //seam'], 7, '#d9a441', 8);
  var gl = now > POK.glitchAt && now < POK.glitchAt + 260, jx = gl ? ((now/40) | 0) % 2 ? 3 : -2 : 0;
  if (now > POK.glitchAt + 260) POK.glitchAt = now + 4500 + Math.random()*3500;
  if (gl) { x.drawImage(POK.bg, 726, 140, 30, 160, 726 + jx, 140 + (jx > 0 ? 2 : -1), 30, 160); }

  x.drawImage(POK.stitch, 726 + (gl ? jx : 0), 140);
  /* a code name instead of a thing, for a moment */
  if (now > POK.nameAt && !L) { POK.nameIdx = (Math.random()*POK.items.length) | 0; POK.nameAt = now + 30000 + Math.random()*40000; POK.nameEnd = now + 140; }
  /* turning a layer: the things sink toward the middle and fade; the next layer rises out of it */
  var TU = POK.turn, tf = 0;
  if (TU) {
    var tp = (now - TU.t0)/460;

    if (TU) tf = tf*tf*(3 - 2*tf);
  }

    x.drawImage(it.sh, ox + 2 - (fy < -1 ? 0 : 0), oy + 3 - Math.round(fy)); x.globalAlpha = 1;

    if (n === POK.hover && !L) { if (!it.Sh) it.Sh = pkSprite(it.id, it.sc, it.rot, it.light*1.22); img = it.Sh.c; }

      continue;
    }

  }
  if (L) pkLiftFrame(now, L);
}
function pkEase(t){ return 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3); }
function pkLiftFrame(now, L){
  var x = pkCx, it = L.it, A = PK_ART[it.id], vid = (L.view && POK.maps[L.view]) ? L.view : it.id, M = POK.maps[vid];   /* (Oct 14) a lifted thing can show another view of itself: the compact, opened */
  var big = Math.min(1, 330/M.h, 560/M.w);   /* the lifted size, so it fits */
  var e = L.t1 >= 0 ? 1 - pkEase(Math.min(1, (now - L.t1)/320)) : pkEase(Math.min(1, (now - L.t0)/320));
  if (L.t1 >= 0 && now - L.t1 > 330) {   /* back where it was */
    POK.lift = null; pkCap.textContent = L.msg || 'tap something.'; if (L.fizz) pkGoneAfterDrink(); return;
  }
  x.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,5,5,' + (0.74*e).toFixed(3) + ')'; x.fillRect(0, 0, PW, PH);
  var g = x.createRadialGradient(PKX, PKY, 10, PKX, PKY, 260); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(228,220,208,' + (0.09*e).toFixed(3) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(228,220,208,0)'); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, PW, PH);
  var cx = it.x + (PKX - it.x)*e, cy = it.y + (PKY - it.y)*e, sc = it.sc + (big - it.sc)*e, rot = it.rot*(1 - e), light = it.light + (1.02 - it.light)*e;
  var fz = L.fizz ? Math.min(1, (now - L.fizz)/900) : 0;
  if (fz >= 1) { if (!L.fizzDone) { L.fizzDone = true; L.t1 = now - 330; L.msg = A.yes; } return; }
  var animating = e < 1 || A.foil || fz > 0;
  if (animating || !L.S || L.Sk !== sc || L.Sv !== vid) { L.S = pkSprite(vid, sc, rot, light*(1 - fz*0.9), A.foil ? now : 0); L.Sk = sc; L.Sv = vid; }
  var S = L.S, wob = fz > 0 ? Math.sin(now/30)*1.5 : 0;
  x.drawImage(S.c, Math.round(cx - S.W/2 + wob), Math.round(cy - S.H/2));
  if (fz > 0) {   /* fizz */
    for (var b = 0; b < 26; b++) { var ph = frac(b*0.137 + (now - L.fizz)/700), bx = cx + (hsh(b, 3) - 0.5)*S.W*0.6, by = cy + S.H*0.3 - ph*(S.H*0.9 + 40); x.fillStyle = 'rgba(228,220,208,' + (0.75*(1 - ph)).toFixed(2) + ')'; var r = 1 + (b % 3); x.fillRect(Math.round(bx), Math.round(by), r, r); }
  }
  if (e >= 1 && !L.done) {   /* up: say what it is, or ask */
    L.done = true;
    if (A.use) { POK.ask = A.use; pkCap.textContent = A.use; pkAsk.style.display = 'flex'; }
    else setTextDeir(pkCap, A.cap);
  }
}

function drawPkIcon(){

  for (var j = 0; j < 22; j++) for (var i = 0; i < 22; i++) {

    else { ri = R_BPLUM; v = 0.5 + (((i + j) & 1) ? 0.05 : 0) - (i === 3 || i === 18 ? 0.14 : 0); if (j > 9 && Math.abs(i - 10.5) + (j - 9)*0.2 < 1.2 && j < 17) { ri = R_BRUST; v = 0.75; } }

  }
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
}

function twStarSvg(cx, cy, R){
  var p = ''; for (var i = 0; i < 24; i++) { var a = i/24*6.2832, r = i % 2 ? R*0.48 : (i % 4 === 0 ? R : R*0.78); p += (i ? ' L' : 'M') + (cx + Math.cos(a)*r).toFixed(2) + ' ' + (cy + Math.sin(a)*r).toFixed(2); }
  return '<path d="' + p + ' Z" fill="#d6b56a" stroke="#6a5a3a" stroke-width="0.3"/><circle cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" r="' + (R*0.36) + '" fill="#3a3834"/><circle cx="' + (cx - R*0.1) + '" cy="' + (cy - R*0.12) + '" r="' + (R*0.11) + '" fill="#f0eee8"/>';
}

function psptHas(id){
  if (id === 'tir' && typeof TWS !== 'undefined' && TWS.stamped) return true;
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nullgrey.stamps') || '[]').indexOf(id) >= 0; } catch (e) { return false; }
}
function psptGuilloche(x0, y0, w, h, seed){
  var s = '', col = '#cfc3b2';
  for (var k = 0; k < 9; k++) { var d = '', ph = k*0.7 + seed;
    for (var i = 0; i <= 40; i++) { var t = i/40, x = x0 + t*w, y = y0 + h*(0.08 + k*0.105) + Math.sin(t*12.566 + ph)*h*0.035 + Math.sin(t*31.4 + ph*2)*h*0.012; d += (i ? ' L' : 'M') + x.toFixed(1) + ' ' + y.toFixed(1); }
    s += '<path d="' + d + '" fill="none" stroke="' + col + '" stroke-width="0.6"/>'; }
  return s;
}

(function(){
  var A = PK_ART.passport; if (!A) return;
  var dU = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(A, 'use'), dY = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(A, 'yes'), on1 = A.onYes, cap0 = A.cap;
  var gU = function(){ return dU ? (dU.get ? dU.get.call(A) : dU.value) : undefined; }, gY = function(){ return dY ? (dY.get ? dY.get.call(A) : dY.value) : undefined; };
  var door = function(){ return typeof TWD !== 'undefined' && TWD.state === 'ask' && typeof twIn === 'function' && twIn(); };
  Object.defineProperty(A, 'use', { configurable:true, get:function(){ return door() ? gU() : (PSPT.open ? 'close it?' : cap0 + ' open it?'); } });
  Object.defineProperty(A, 'yes', { configurable:true, get:function(){ return door() ? gY() : (PSPT.open ? 'you close it. it stays warm in your hand.' : 'page 12, then page 14. there was never a 13.'); } });
  var lift0 = A.onLift;
  A.onLift = function(L){ PSPT.open = false; L.view = null; if (lift0) lift0(L); };   /* it always comes out shut */
  A.onYes = function(it, L){
    if (door()) { if (on1) on1(it, L); return; }
    PSPT.open = !PSPT.open;
    var again = function(){ setTimeout(function(){ if (POK.lift === L && L.t1 < 0) { L.used = false; POK.ask = A.use; pkCap.textContent = A.use; pkAsk.style.display = 'flex'; } }, 2600); };
    if (!PSPT.open) { if (L) { L.view = null; L.S = null; } again(); return; }
    pkMap('passportOpen', function(){ if (L && POK.lift === L) { L.view = 'passportOpen'; L.S = null; } again(); });   /* redrawn each time: a new stamp shows */
  };
})();

   THE STRANGER'S NOTE, AND THE STATE NEWSPAPER, IN THE КУКУРИ CARRIAGE (Oct 20; doc 21, "The note on the floor"
   and "One small thing to click in each carriage").
   the note: a small crumpled paper half under a seat, dark on the dark floor, only on the ride toward Vahitorn. click it:
   it lifts up close. take it, and it goes in your pocket. written by a stranger, not a good person, never found out:
   big shaky letters leaning different ways, "ruined" struck through, "broke" scribbled over, CORRUPTED gone over three
   times, a tear where the pen went through, "it" trailing off the edge. then, smaller, cramped in the corner: your own
   passport number, your real local time, how long you've been in the station (all visits added up). after 3 hours,
   a new message pressed hard in rust in the empty top corner. it's written fresh every time you look at it.
   (Aisling's text, final Sept 28. the lettering is a handwriting font drawn letter by letter, shaky, until there's
   hand-drawn lettering, doc 21.)
   the newspaper: МЕЖДУ, folded on a seat. click it: you read the front page (a headline that changes each visit),
   then put it back. it isn't yours to keep (the one on Plt 1's bench is).
   ================================================================ */

/* ---- how long you've been in the station, all visits added up (kept in this browser only) ---- */
var NGT = { ms:0, last:performance.now() };
try { NGT.ms = +localStorage.getItem('nullgrey.between.time') || 0; } catch (e) {}
function ngTick(){ var n = performance.now(); if (!document.hidden) NGT.ms += Math.min(20000, n - NGT.last); NGT.last = n; try { localStorage.setItem('nullgrey.between.time', String(Math.round(NGT.ms))); } catch (e) {} }
setInterval(ngTick, 10000);
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', function(){ if (document.hidden) ngTick(); else NGT.last = performance.now(); });
function ngTimeMs(){ return NGT.ms + (document.hidden ? 0 : performance.now() - NGT.last); }
function noteSpent(){
  var m = Math.floor(ngTimeMs()/60000), h = Math.floor(m/60); m = m % 60;
  if (!h && !m) return 'less than a minute';
  var s = h ? h + (h === 1 ? ' hour' : ' hours') : '';
  if (m) s += (s ? ' ' : '') + m + (m === 1 ? ' minute' : ' minutes');
  return s;
}
function noteLocalTime(){ var d = new Date(), h = d.getHours(), m = d.getMinutes(), ap = h >= 12 ? 'pm' : 'am'; h = h % 12 || 12; return h + ':' + (m < 10 ? '0' : '') + m + ap; }
function noteAfter3h(){ return ngTimeMs() >= 3*3600000; }

/* ---- the paper and the hand ---- */
var NOTE = { bg:null, fonts:null, W:600, H:450 };
var NOTE_PAPER = 'M38,34 L562,22 L574,410 L300,428 L26,420 Z';
function noteReady(cb){
  if (NOTE.bg && NOTE.fontsOk) { cb(); return; }
  var left = 2; function one(){ if (--left === 0) cb(); }
  if (!NOTE.fonts) {

    catch (e) { NOTE.fonts = Promise.resolve(); }
  }
  NOTE.fonts.then(function(){ NOTE.fontsOk = true; one(); }, function(){ NOTE.fontsOk = true; one(); });
  if (NOTE.bg) one();
  else {   /* the crumpled paper: drawn once (its creases are lit from the top left), the writing goes on each time */
    var svg = '<defs><filter id="cr" x="0" y="0" width="100%" height="100%"><feTurbulence type="fractalNoise" baseFrequency=".018" numOctaves="3" seed="9" result="n"/><feDiffuseLighting in="n" surfaceScale="3.2" lighting-color="#e2d9c8" result="l"><feDistantLight azimuth="235" elevation="52"/></feDiffuseLighting><feComposite in="l" in2="SourceGraphic" operator="in"/></filter>' +

      '<g clip-path="url(#pc)"><rect width="600" height="450" fill="#d8cfbf" filter="url(#cr)" opacity=".45"/><rect width="600" height="450" fill="#d8cfbf" filter="url(#gr)"/>' +
      '<path d="M40,150 Q300,140 572,160" stroke="#b3a893" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><path d="M300,20 Q296,220 306,430" stroke="#b3a893" stroke-width="1.2" fill="none"/><path d="M40,300 Q260,290 572,306" stroke="#bdb29e" stroke-width=".8" fill="none"/>' +

    var img = new Image();
    img.onload = function(){ var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 600; c.height = 450; c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img, 0, 0); NOTE.bg = c; one(); };

/* one line, letter by letter: each letter leans its own way and jumps a little, the pen shakes (drawn twice, a hair apart) */
function noteScrawl(g, t, x, y, size, o){
  o = o || {}; var seed = o.seed || 1; function R(){ seed = (seed*9301 + 49297) % 233280; return seed/233280; }
  if (o.maxW) {   /* (Oct 20: a line that would run off the paper is written smaller, the way a hand squeezes it in) */
    g.save(); g.font = (o.w ? '700 ' : '') + size + 'px ' + (o.font || 'NoteReenie, cursive'); var tw = g.measureText(t).width*(o.scary ? 1.08 : 1) + (o.ls || 0)*t.length; g.restore();
    if (tw > o.maxW) size = Math.floor(size*o.maxW/tw);
  }
  var font = (o.w ? '700 ' : '') + size + 'px ' + (o.font || 'NoteReenie, cursive');
  g.save(); g.translate(x, y); g.rotate((o.r || 0)*Math.PI/180); g.font = font; g.fillStyle = o.col || '#1c1714'; g.textBaseline = 'alphabetic';
  if (o.op) g.globalAlpha = o.op;
  var cx = 0, prev = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < t.length; i++) {
    var ch = t[i], rot = (R() - 0.5)*(o.wob || 14)*Math.PI/180, d = (R() - 0.5)*(o.jit || 3), dy = d;
    if (ch === '№') {   /* №: the hand writes N, a small raised o, a line under it */
      g.save(); g.translate(cx, dy); g.rotate(rot); g.fillText('N', 0, 0); var nw = g.measureText('N').width;
      g.font = (o.w ? '700 ' : '') + Math.round(size*0.6) + 'px ' + (o.font || 'NoteReenie, cursive'); g.fillText('o', nw*0.95, -size*0.28); var ow = g.measureText('o').width;
      g.fillRect(nw*0.95, -size*0.2, ow, Math.max(1, size*0.05)); g.restore(); g.font = font; cx += nw + ow + size*0.12; continue;
    }
    var sz = o.scary ? size*(0.86 + R()*0.34) : size, sx = o.scary ? 0.85 + R()*0.35 : 1;   /* (the big lines: each letter its own size, squashed or stretched, pushed hard) */
    if (o.scary) { g.font = (o.w ? '700 ' : '') + Math.round(sz) + 'px ' + (o.font || 'NoteReenie, cursive'); rot *= 2.1; dy *= 1.8; }
    if (o.scary && ch === '.') { cx += size*0.08; rot *= 0.2; dy = Math.abs(dy)*0.3; }   /* (a full stop sits on the line, a little apart, so it doesn't vanish into the last letter) */
    var dig = ch >= '0' && ch <= '9', drift = o.drift ? Math.sin(i*0.31 + (o.seed || 0))*size*0.08 + i*size*(o.drift - 0.5)*0.025 : 0;   /* (the cramped lines wander up and down a little as the hand moves along) */
    if (dig && !o.scary) {   /* numbers by hand: never two the same size or lean, crowded or spread, a little higher or lower (Aisling: they read "printed") */
      sz = size*(0.9 + R()*0.2); sx = 0.86 + R()*0.24; g.font = (o.w ? '700 ' : '') + Math.round(sz) + 'px ' + (o.font || 'NoteReenie, cursive');
      rot = (R() - 0.5)*18*Math.PI/180; dy += (R() - 0.5)*size*0.14; cx += (R() - 0.4)*size*0.08;
    }
    dy += drift;
    var w = g.measureText(ch).width*sx;
    if (dig) g.globalAlpha = (o.op || 1)*(0.78 + R()*0.22);   /* (and the pen presses unevenly) */
    g.save(); g.translate(cx + w/2, dy); g.rotate(rot); g.scale(sx, 1); g.fillText(ch, -w/2/sx, 0); if (o.heavy) { g.strokeStyle = g.fillStyle; g.lineWidth = o.heavy; g.lineJoin = 'round'; g.strokeText(ch, -w/2/sx, 0); } g.globalAlpha *= 0.4; g.fillText(ch, -w/2/sx + 0.9, 0.7); if (o.scary) { g.globalAlpha *= 0.8; g.fillText(ch, -w/2/sx - 0.6, -0.8); } g.restore();
    cx += w + (o.ls || 0);
    if (dig) { g.globalAlpha = o.op || 1; g.font = font; }
  }
  g.restore();
  return cx;
}
function notePaint(g, w, h){
  var ink = '#1c1714', rust = '#73361f';
  g.save(); g.scale(w/600, h/450);
  if (NOTE.bg) g.drawImage(NOTE.bg, 0, 0);
  g.translate(300, 225); g.rotate(-2.5*Math.PI/180); g.translate(-300, -225);
  noteScrawl(g, "3 aisling's.", 66, 80, 48, { r:-3, wob:16, jit:4, seed:3, scary:1 });
  noteScrawl(g, '2 created 1.', 92, 132, 46, { r:2, wob:18, jit:5, seed:7, scary:1 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'ukiyo is a combination.', 56, 184, 42, { r:-1.5, wob:12, jit:4, seed:11, scary:1 });
  noteScrawl(g, "father's wonderland —", 60, 236, 42, { r:1, wob:14, jit:4, seed:15, scary:1 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'they', 62, 284, 38, { r:-2, wob:10, seed:19, scary:1 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'ruined', 136, 284, 36, { r:-2, wob:12, seed:23 });
  g.strokeStyle = ink; g.lineCap = 'round'; g.lineWidth = 3; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(134, 272); g.lineTo(216, 267); g.stroke();   /* struck through */
  noteScrawl(g, 'broke', 228, 282, 36, { r:3, wob:12, seed:27 });
  g.lineWidth = 2.4; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(226, 269); [[12, 6], [12, -8], [12, 8], [12, -6], [12, 6], [8, -4]].reduce(function(p, s){ var q = [p[0] + s[0], p[1] + s[1]]; g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); return q; }, [226, 269]); g.stroke();   /* scribbled over */
  g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(224, 276); [[11, -5], [12, 7], [12, -7], [12, 6], [12, -5], [10, 3]].reduce(function(p, s){ var q = [p[0] + s[0], p[1] + s[1]]; g.lineTo(q[0], q[1]); return q; }, [224, 276]); g.stroke();
  noteScrawl(g, 'CORRUPTED', 302, 290, 46, { r:-4, wob:6, jit:2, seed:31, w:1 });   /* gone over three times */
  noteScrawl(g, 'CORRUPTED', 304, 291, 46, { r:-3.4, wob:7, jit:2, seed:31, w:1, op:0.8 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'CORRUPTED', 301, 288, 46, { r:-4.6, wob:6, jit:2, seed:31, w:1, op:0.7 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'it', 520, 280, 40, { r:8, wob:14, seed:35, scary:1 });
  g.lineWidth = 2; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(538, 268); g.bezierCurveTo(556, 264, 572, 280, 600, 274); g.stroke();   /* trailing off the edge */
  /* smaller, cramped, bottom right, like it was added later */
  var pass = (typeof KASSA !== 'undefined' && KASSA.pass) ? String(KASSA.pass) : null;
  g.save(); g.translate(420, 360); g.rotate(-4*Math.PI/180); g.translate(-420, -360);
  noteScrawl(g, pass ? 'i can see you. № ' + pass : 'i can see you. you have no №.', 300, 322, 19, { wob:9, jit:2, seed:41, drift:0.5 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'on your side of the null.grey', 294, 340, 18, { wob:9, jit:2, seed:43, drift:0.7 });
  noteScrawl(g, "it's " + noteLocalTime() + ' local time.', 310, 357, 18, { wob:9, jit:2, seed:45, drift:0.45 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'you have been inbetween', 298, 375, 18, { wob:10, jit:2, seed:47, drift:0.2 });
  noteScrawl(g, noteSpent() + '.', 330, 392, 18, { wob:10, jit:2, seed:49, drift:0.4 });
  noteScrawl(g, 'i know which one you are.', 304, 409, 19, { wob:11, jit:2.5, seed:53, drift:0.6 });
  g.restore();
  if (noteAfter3h()) {   /* in rust, the same hand, pressed hard enough to dent the paper, squeezed into the empty top corner (and kept on the paper) */
    g.save(); g.translate(440, 90); g.rotate(4*Math.PI/180); g.translate(-440, -90);
    [[1.1, 1.5, 'rgba(110,100,80,0.5)'], [0, 0, rust]].forEach(function(L){ g.save(); g.translate(L[0], L[1]);
      var o = { col:L[2], scary:1, heavy:1.6 };   /* (pressed hard: a heavier line) */
      noteScrawl(g, 'i can still see you.', 336, 62, 30, Object.assign({ wob:12, jit:3, seed:61, maxW:200 }, o));
      noteScrawl(g, 'go back to your', 350, 94, 29, Object.assign({ wob:12, jit:3, seed:67, maxW:188 }, o));
      noteScrawl(g, 'side of the leak.', 340, 126, 30, Object.assign({ wob:14, jit:3.5, seed:71, maxW:196 }, o)); g.restore(); });
    g.restore();
  }
  g.restore();
}

  });

/* ================================================================
   f8 — FURUSATO'S SOUND (the immersive-space kit, doc 29). the same rules as the station:
   off until asked for (the switch, top right, the same memory as the station page, so it's
   on here if you turned it on there), quiet, no hover sounds.
     - footsteps: the station's own recording, crisp on tile, a short bright echo
     - the tubes: the station's real fluorescent hum, low, everywhere on the platform
     - the pocket: the pickup sound for each kind of thing; cans open, bottles pop, a sip, a bite, a wrapper
   Furusato's own sounds (its station drifting in, the departure melody, the gacha, the ramen counter)
   come later (step 9). the code is the station's hr-sound.js / hr-sound-rec.js / r3k / hph, trimmed.
   ================================================================ */
var SND = { on:false, ctx:null, el:null, step:0, lx:0, ly:0, buf:{} };
try { SND.on = localStorage.getItem('nullgrey.between.sound') === 'on'; } catch (e) {}
function sndImpulse(ctx, sec, decay, bright){
  var n = Math.floor(ctx.sampleRate*sec), b = ctx.createBuffer(2, n, ctx.sampleRate);
  for (var c = 0; c < 2; c++) { var d = b.getChannelData(c), lp = 0; for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var w = Math.random()*2 - 1; lp += (w - lp)*bright; d[i] = lp*Math.pow(1 - i/n, decay); } }
  return b;
}
function sndBuild(){
  var ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(), S = SND; S.ctx = ctx;
  S.master = ctx.createGain(); S.master.gain.value = 0; S.lim = ctx.createDynamicsCompressor(); S.lim.threshold.value = -10; S.lim.ratio.value = 12; S.master.connect(S.lim); S.lim.connect(ctx.destination);
  S.revTile = ctx.createConvolver(); S.revTile.buffer = sndImpulse(ctx, 1.1, 3.2, 0.5);   /* tile all round: a short, bright echo */
  S.sendTile = ctx.createGain(); S.sendTile.gain.value = 0.32; S.sendTile.connect(S.revTile); S.revTile.connect(S.master);
  S.dry = ctx.createGain(); S.dry.connect(S.master); S.dry.connect(S.sendTile);
  S.hum = ctx.createGain(); S.hum.gain.value = 0; S.hum.connect(S.master);
  Object.keys(SND_DATA).forEach(function(k){
    try { fetch(SND_DATA[k]).then(function(r){ return r.arrayBuffer(); }).then(function(a){ return ctx.decodeAudioData(a); }).then(function(b){ S.buf[k] = b; if (k === 'fl_hum') { var h = ctx.createBufferSource(); h.buffer = b; h.loop = true; h.connect(S.hum); h.start(); } }).catch(function(){}); } catch (e) {}
  });
}
function sndOneShot(k, out, vol, rate, off){
  var S = SND; if (!S.on || !S.ctx || !S.buf[k]) return null;
  var s = S.ctx.createBufferSource(), g = S.ctx.createGain(); s.buffer = S.buf[k]; s.playbackRate.value = rate || 1; g.gain.value = vol; s.connect(g); g.connect(out); s.start(0, off || 0); return s;
}
var SND_VOL = 3.2;
var SND_STEPS = [0.0,0.35,0.7,1.05,1.4,1.75,2.1,2.45,2.8,3.15,3.5,3.85], SND_STEPLEN = 0.31, SND_LASTSTEP = -1;
function sndFoot(){
  var S = SND; if (!S.on || !S.ctx || !S.buf.steps) return;
  var k; do { k = Math.floor(Math.random()*SND_STEPS.length); } while (k === SND_LASTSTEP); SND_LASTSTEP = k;
  var src = S.ctx.createBufferSource(), g = S.ctx.createGain();
  src.buffer = S.buf.steps; src.playbackRate.value = 1.06 + (Math.random() - 0.5)*0.08; g.gain.value = 0.0675;
  src.connect(g); g.connect(S.dry); src.start(0, SND_STEPS[k], SND_STEPLEN);
}
function sndStep(now, dt){
  var S = SND; if (!S.on || !S.ctx) return;
  var T = S.ctx.currentTime, ch = cellAt(Math.floor(me.x), Math.floor(me.y));
  S.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(NGJ.leaving ? 0 : SND_VOL, T, 0.3);
  var under = ch === 'n' ? 0 : (ch === 'g' || ch === 'k' || ch === 'r' || ch === 'l' ? 0.5 : 1);   /* the side rooms are quieter; the narrow way has no tubes */
  S.hum.gain.setTargetAtTime(0.007*under, T, 0.3);
  var mv = Math.hypot(me.x - S.lx, me.y - S.ly); S.lx = me.x; S.ly = me.y;
  if (mv > 0 && mv < 0.5) { S.step += mv; if (S.step > 0.62) { S.step = 0; sndFoot(); } }
}
function sndSwitch(){
  if (SND.el) return;
  var el = document.createElement('button'); el.type = 'button'; el.id = 'snd-switch'; SND.el = el;
  el.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;right:2%;top:3%;z-index:30;font:10px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:rgba(228,220,208,.55);background:rgba(10,9,8,.35);border:0;padding:3px 7px;cursor:' + HANDS.pointer + ';';
  function label(){ el.textContent = SND.on ? '音 · sound on' : '音 · sound off'; }
  label();
  ['pointerdown', 'mousedown', 'touchstart'].forEach(function(t){ el.addEventListener(t, function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); }); });
  el.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation(); SND.on = !SND.on; label();
    try { localStorage.setItem('nullgrey.between.sound', SND.on ? 'on' : 'off'); } catch (er) {}
    if (SND.on) { if (!SND.ctx) { try { sndBuild(); } catch (er2) { SND.on = false; label(); return; } } SND.ctx.resume(); SND.lx = me.x; SND.ly = me.y; }
    else if (SND.ctx) SND.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, SND.ctx.currentTime, 0.1);
  });

/* (Oct 28) white girl's matchbook brings its own inks: the usual ones, and the dusty rose and greens of its sky and tags
   (the pocket's own inks would turn the rose lilac, which leans blue) */
var PK_INKS_WG = null, PK_INKC_WG = {};
function pkInkWG(r, g, b){
  if (!PK_INKS_WG) { PK_INKS_WG = PK_INKS.slice(); ['hmauve', 'hrose', 'hglgreen', 'hcream'].forEach(function(nm){ var ri = RIX[nm]; if (ri === undefined) return; var n = RN[ri]; for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var c = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + k]; PK_INKS_WG.push([ri, (k + 0.5)/n, c & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, (c >> 16) & 255]); } }); }
  var key = (r >> 2) << 12 | (g >> 2) << 6 | (b >> 2), c = PK_INKC_WG[key]; if (c) return c; var best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (var k = 0; k < PK_INKS_WG.length; k++) { var q = PK_INKS_WG[k], dr = r - q[2], dg = g - q[3], db = b - q[4], d = dr*dr*0.3 + dg*dg*0.59 + db*db*0.11; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } }
  PK_INKC_WG[key] = best; return best;
}

/* ================================================================
   shared/surface.js: ONE FINISH FOR THE WHOLE STATION (Oct 30)
   Aisling: "I want the whole train station to feel cohesive this level of the game should all feel similar
   the same world but also furu is a different style ... as long as the two feel like the same art style
   and game I'm good."
   So every surface gets the same kind of age: a little unevenness, hairline cracks, grime low down, scuffs
   underfoot, polish where people walk. each place keeps its own materials (Furusato's small glazed tile and
   honed floor tile, the hub's plaster, dark wood and terrazzo); these are the shared recipes they use.
   all of them only nudge a value along the ramp it's already on: no new colours, no blue.
   open a page with ?notex on the end to see it without (for comparing).
   used by Furusato and Main Street (f7c), and by the hub (its copy, hy0-surface.js).
   ================================================================ */
function surfOn(){ if (surfOn.v === undefined) { try { surfOn.v = !/[?&]notex\b/.test(location.search); } catch (e) { surfOn.v = true; } } return surfOn.v; }
/* twice the pixels on tiled walls and floors, so a tile has room for its surface. a function declaration,
   so the wall and floor lists, which are made before this file runs, can already ask it */
function fTexRes(r){ return surfOn() ? r*2 : r; }
/* crazing: the edges of a loose cell pattern; how near the nearest crack is (0 on it) */
function surfCraze(x, y, seed){
  var xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y), d1 = 9, d2 = 9;
  for (var j = -1; j <= 1; j++) for (var i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    var px = xi + i + hsh(xi + i + seed*31, yi + j + 7), py = yi + j + hsh(xi + i + 3, yi + j + seed*17), d = (px - x)*(px - x) + (py - y)*(py - y);
    if (d < d1) { d2 = d1; d1 = d; } else if (d < d2) d2 = d;
  }
  return Math.sqrt(d2) - Math.sqrt(d1);
}
/* plaster (or any painted flat): trowel marks, a slow unevenness, the odd hairline crack, grime low down.
   x along the wall, h the height (units) */
function surfPlaster(v, x, h, k){
  if (!surfOn()) return v; k = k || 1;
  v += k*(0.03*(vn(x*1.7 + 2.3, h*1.1) - 0.5) + 0.016*(vn(x*7 + h*2.2, h*3.4 - x) - 0.5));        /* trowel sweeps, soft */
  var m = vn(x*0.37 + 9.1, h*0.5 + 4.4);
  if (m > 0.66) { var c = surfCraze(x*2.6, h*2.6, 3); if (c < 0.022) v -= k*0.07*(1 - c/0.022); }   /* a hairline, here and there */
  if (h < 0.6) v -= k*0.05*(1 - h/0.6)*(0.5 + 0.5*vn(x*3.1, h*6));                                 /* grime low down */
  return v;
}
/* wood: deeper grain, and edges rubbed paler where hands and bags go. along / across the grain, h height */
function surfWood(v, along, across, h, k){
  if (!surfOn()) return v; k = k || 1;
  v += k*(0.035*(vn(along*2.4, across*70) - 0.5) + 0.02*Math.sin(across*140 + vn(along*1.3, across*6)*7));
  if (h !== undefined && h > 0.8 && h < 1.1) v += k*0.03*vn(along*4, 3.3);                         /* rubbed at hand height */
  return v;
}
/* underfoot, any floor: heel marks and scuffs (short dark strokes), dirt in the corners of things,
   and a polish where people walk (lane: 0..1, how walked this spot is) */
function surfFloor(v, x, y, lane, k){
  if (!surfOn()) return v; k = k || 1;
  var sx = x*10, sy = y*40, sk = hsh(Math.floor(sx), Math.floor(sy)), sd = Math.abs((sy - Math.floor(sy)) - 0.5);
  if (sk > 0.88 && sd < 0.07) v -= k*0.1*(1 - sd/0.07)*vn(x*60, y*60);
  var bx = x*9 + 50, by = y*9, bk = hsh(Math.floor(bx), Math.floor(by) + 3), bd = Math.abs((bx - Math.floor(bx)) - 0.5);
  if (bk > 0.93 && bd < 0.05) v -= k*0.08*(1 - bd/0.05)*vn(x*50, y*50);                            /* the odd scuff across */
  v += k*0.02*(vn(x*2.2, y*2.2) - 0.5);                                                               /* foot-dirt, uneven */
  if (lane) v += k*0.03*lane*(0.6 + 0.4*vn(x*1.1, y*1.1));                                           /* polished by walking */
  return v;
}
/* a small glazed tile's surface (no grout, no chip): pillow, uneven glaze, a drip, crazing, a soft sheen.
   fx, fy across the tile 0..1; h1..h3 the tile's own random numbers; wx, wy where it is */
function surfGlaze(v, fx, fy, h1, h2, h3, wx, wy, seed){
  if (!surfOn()) return v;
  var e = Math.min(fx, 1 - fx, fy, 1 - fy);
  v *= 0.84 + 0.16*sm(0, 0.18, e);
  v += 0.07*(vn(wx*3.2 + h2*9, wy*3.2 + h3*9) - 0.5) + 0.03*(vn(wx*11, wy*11) - 0.5) + 0.05*(h2 - 0.5);
  if (h2 > 0.7 && fy > 0.78) v -= 0.07*sm(0.78, 0.95, fy)*(0.5 + 0.5*Math.sin(fx*9 + h3*6));
  if (h1 > 0.62) { var c = surfCraze(fx*4.2 + h2*13, fy*4.2 + h3*13, seed || 0); if (c < 0.07) v -= 0.11*(1 - c/0.07)*(0.6 + 0.4*h1); }
  var g = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.hypot(fx - 0.32, fy - 0.28)*2.1); v *= 1 + 0.1*g*g*g;
  return v;
}
/* a honed (unglazed) floor tile's body: flecks, unevenness, the edge worn round */
function surfHoned(v, fx, fy, h2, wx, wy, k){
  if (!surfOn()) return v; k = k || 1;
  var f = hsh(Math.floor(wx*48), Math.floor(wy*48));
  if (f > 0.9) v += k*0.09; else if (f < 0.08) v -= k*0.1;
  v += k*(0.05*(vn(wx*7 + h2*5, wy*7) - 0.5) + 0.04*(h2 - 0.5));
  var e = Math.min(fx, 1 - fx, fy, 1 - fy); v *= 1 - k*0.12*(1 - sm(0, 0.1, e));
  return v;
}

;
/* ---- copied from null.grey-furusatostation/src/shared/furu-shop.js ---- */
/* (Oct 30, Aisling: "all faces on magazines and such should just be blank or static") a face is TV static: the head's
   shape stays, where the face was there is snow and scanlines, nobody's features */
var FU_STATIC_N = 0;
function fuStatic(cx, cy, rx, ry){
  var id = 'fst' + (FU_STATIC_N++), s = '<defs><clipPath id="' + id + '"><ellipse cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" rx="' + rx + '" ry="' + ry + '"/></clipPath></defs><g clip-path="url(#' + id + ')"><rect x="' + (cx - rx) + '" y="' + (cy - ry) + '" width="' + (rx*2) + '" height="' + (ry*2) + '" fill="#9e9a94"/>';
  var n = Math.round(rx*ry*1.6), g = Math.max(0.35, rx/9);
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var u = ((i*0.618034) % 1), v = ((i*0.414214 + (i % 7)*0.13) % 1), c = ['#e8e4dc', '#5d5a54', '#c7c3ba', '#3a3632'][i % 4];
    s += '<rect x="' + (cx - rx + u*rx*2).toFixed(2) + '" y="' + (cy - ry + v*ry*2).toFixed(2) + '" width="' + (g*(1 + (i % 3))).toFixed(2) + '" height="' + (g*0.7).toFixed(2) + '" fill="' + c + '"/>'; }
  for (var y = cy - ry; y < cy + ry; y += g*2.2) s += '<rect x="' + (cx - rx) + '" y="' + y.toFixed(2) + '" width="' + (rx*2) + '" height="' + (g*0.5).toFixed(2) + '" fill="#2a2628" opacity="0.25"/>';
  return s + '</g><ellipse cx="' + cx + '" cy="' + cy + '" rx="' + rx + '" ry="' + ry + '" fill="none" stroke="#5d5a54" stroke-width="' + (g*0.5).toFixed(2) + '" opacity="0.6"/>';
}
/* ================================================================
   THE KIOSK, FILLED (Oct 28). shared: both pages (so everything bought on Furusato is still in your pocket upstairs).
   Aisling sent her references: the sweets she loves, from Japan, Russia, America, China, Germany; the drinks; the
   magazines; and "this store sells things like calculators and disposable and cheap cameras and film too … its
   important this world has cameras and photography, especially since all the aislings are into photography and worked

var FU_SHOP = { sweets:[], gum:[], far:[], drinks:[], papers:[], camera:[], things:[] };
/* the pocket's inks, with the pinks, golds and greens these packets need (the plain inks turn pink lilac, which leans blue) */
var PK_INKS_SHOP = null, PK_INKC_SHOP = {};
function pkInkShop(r, g, b){
  if (!PK_INKS_SHOP) { PK_INKS_SHOP = PK_INKS.slice(); ['hglrose', 'hrose', 'hmauve', 'hglgold', 'hglgreen', 'hamber', 'hcream', 'hblood', 'hsage', 'hgilt'].forEach(function(nm){ var ri = RIX[nm]; if (ri === undefined) return; var n = RN[ri]; for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var c = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + k]; PK_INKS_SHOP.push([ri, (k + 0.5)/n, c & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, (c >> 16) & 255]); } }); }
  var key = (r >> 2) << 12 | (g >> 2) << 6 | (b >> 2), c = PK_INKC_SHOP[key]; if (c) return c; var best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (var k = 0; k < PK_INKS_SHOP.length; k++) { var q = PK_INKS_SHOP[k], dr = r - q[2], dg = g - q[3], db = b - q[4], d = dr*dr*0.3 + dg*dg*0.59 + db*db*0.11; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } }
  PK_INKC_SHOP[key] = best; return best;
}

/* (Oct 30, Aisling: "make the magazines more detailed, like very detailed, we can break the art style a little bit here")
   the five magazines' covers, drawn properly: mastheads with their outlines and shadows, issue numbers, prices, barcodes,
   cover lines, the free-gift burst, and the cover pictures with their linework and shading. same names, same words. */
(function(){
  var J = 'Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif', E = 'Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif', M = 'Hiragino Mincho ProN, Yu Mincho, serif';
  function t(s, x, y, sz, fill, o){ o = o || {}; return '<text x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" text-anchor="' + (o.a || 'middle') + '" font-family="' + (o.f || J) + '" font-weight="' + (o.w || 800) + '" font-size="' + sz + '" fill="' + fill + '"' + (o.st ? ' stroke="' + o.st + '" stroke-width="' + (o.sw || 0.6) + '" paint-order="stroke" stroke-linejoin="round"' : '') + (o.ls ? ' letter-spacing="' + o.ls + '"' : '') + (o.tf ? (function(){
  if (typeof PK_ART === 'undefined') return;
  var J = 'Hiragino Sans, Noto Sans JP, sans-serif', E = 'Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif', M = 'Hiragino Mincho ProN, Yu Mincho, serif', K = '#1e1714', CR = '#f2ece0';
  function t(s, x, y, sz, fill, o){ o = o || {}; return '<text x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" text-anchor="' + (o.a || 'middle') + '" font-family="' + (o.f || J) + '" font-weight="' + (o.w || 800) + '" font-size="' + sz + '" fill="' + fill + '"' + (o.st ?   /* a glass bottle, 30 × 70: its glass, the liquid, the cap and its ridges, the label (art inside 6..24 × 30..56) */

      drops([[22, 22], [23.6, 26], [21, 40], [24, 60], [6, 59]]);
  }
  /* a can, 32 × 56: its rim and tab, the ridges top and bottom, the metal's shine (art inside 4..28 × 8..50) */

/* ================================================================
   POCKETS IN THE POCKET (step 6, round 1b, Oct 24). shared: the same file is in both pages.
   Aisling: "pockets in pockets, with different real stitches on each one … a mix of colours on all of them,
   but each pocket's stitch has a little more of a different colour … enough to notice and memorize and pick out
   by sight, but not obtrusive … slightly reflective and interesting thread … stitched-in labels, readability
   more important than it looking like real stitching … a tiny tiny sound as they open … pages like we have now
   in the sub folders … keep the layers deeper thing … change none of the rest".
   - the top layer: the little pockets sewn along the wall under the lip, the loose things (passport, multipass,
     the pass, Ivan's note, the lint) lying below them.
   - one layer deeper, always: the Kodama ticket, too far down to lift, as before.
   - tap a little pocket: a tiny soft sound, the pocket sinks into it, and you're inside: its own things, its
     own layers going deeper, its thread round the rim and its label stitched under the lip. ↑ out comes back.

   ================================================================ */

function pkFolderOf(id){
  var A = PK_ART[id];
  if (A && A.folder) return A.folder;
  if (PK_FOLDER_OF[id]) return PK_FOLDER_OF[id];
  if (/^f_gc_/.test(id)) return 'capsule';
  if (/^f_pack_/.test(id)) return 'junk';
  if (/^f_(tk_|match|oldtickets)/.test(id)) return 'paper';
  if (/^f_(button|gothic|buildings|moss|rails|radio|puzzle|edge|furupaper|ukiyopaper|dreambook)$/.test(id)) return 'reading';
  var F = typeof FU_ITEMS !== 'undefined' && FU_ITEMS[id];
  if (F && F.kind === 'sweet') return pkFoldersShown().some(function(Q){ return Q.id === 'sweets'; }) ? 'sweets' : 'food';
  if (F && (F.kind === 'drink' || F.kind === 'food')) return 'food';
  return 'things';
}
function pkFoldersShown(){
  var gc = false; try { gc = !!localStorage.getItem('nullgrey.capsules'); } catch (e) {}
  if (!gc) gc = PK_HAVE.some(function(id){ return /^f_gc_/.test(id); });
  return PK_FOLDERS.filter(function(F){ return !F.late || (F.when ? F.when() : gc); });
}

/* ---- the thread: every pocket's stitches mix all the inks, one of them a little more ---- */
function pkThreadRamps(){
  var all = ['amber', 'paper', 'plumglow', 'silver', 'holive', 'bRust', 'gold', 'amber', 'paper'].map(function(n){ return RIX[n] !== undefined ? RIX[n] : R_GOLD; });
  return all;
}
function pkThreadPick(F, seed){
  var mine = RIX[F.ink] !== undefined ? RIX[F.ink] : R_GOLD, h = hsh(seed, 77);
  if (h < 0.58) return mine;
  var all = pkThreadRamps(); return all[(hsh(seed, 78)*all.length) | 0];
}
function pkPx(d, W, i, j, ri, v){ var nR = RN[ri], b = BAY[((j & 3) << 2) | (i & 3)], ix = (Math.max(0, v)*(nR - 1) + b) | 0; if (ix >= nR) ix = nR - 1; d[j*W + i] = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + ix]; }
/* the label as hard pixels (readable first) */
function pkLabelMask(t, font, px){
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'), x = c.getContext('2d'); x.font = font; var w = Math.ceil(x.measureText(t).width) + 2;
  c.width = w; c.height = px + 4; x = c.getContext('2d'); x.font = font; x.fillStyle = '#fff'; x.textBaseline = 'top'; x.fillText(t, 1, 1);
  var d = x.getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data, m = new Uint8Array(c.width*c.height);
  for (var k = 0; k < m.length; k++) m[k] = d[k*4 + 3] > 120 ? 1 : 0;
  return { w:c.width, h:c.height, m:m };
}

var PK_JPFONT = '"IBM Plex Sans JP","Hiragino Sans","Noto Sans CJK JP",sans-serif';   /* the site's fonts (style reference): Plex Mono, its Japanese from Plex Sans JP */
var PK_ENFONT = '"IBM Plex Mono",monospace';

function pkPouchSprite(F, light, fi){
  var W = PK_POUCH_W, H = PK_POUCH_H, c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = H;
  var x = c.getContext('2d'), id = x.createImageData(W, H), d = new Uint32Array(id.data.buffer), mask = new Uint8Array(W*H), thr = [];
  function inside(i, j){ if (i < 1 || i > W - 2 || j < 0) return false; if (j < H - 22) return true; var ex = (i - W/2)/(W/2 - 1), ey = (j - (H - 22))/21; return ex*ex + ey*ey <= 1; }
  function edge(i, j){ var e = 9; for (var r = 1; r < 9; r++) if (!inside(i - r, j) || !inside(i + r, j) || !inside(i, j + r)) { e = r; break; } return e; }
  for (var j = 0; j < H; j++) for (var i = 0; i < W; i++) {
    if (!inside(i, j)) continue; mask[j*W + i] = 1;
    var v = 0.2 + (frac((i*0.5 + j*0.5)/2.6) < 0.5 ? 0.03 : 0) + (hsh(i + fi*31, j + 5) - 0.5)*0.06 + (vn(i*0.07 + fi, j*0.09) - 0.5)*0.05;   /* the same wool, a shade lighter: sewn on top */
    var e = edge(i, j); if (e < 3) v *= 0.7 + 0.1*e;
    if (j < 9) v = j < 2 ? 0.3 : (j < 4 ? 0.06 : 0.11 + j*0.008);   /* its mouth: a folded edge, then the dark of the opening */
    pkPx(d, W, i, j, R_BPLUM, v*light);
  }
  /* the running stitch round its sides and bottom, 3 in from the edge, each stitch its own thread */
  var path = [];
  for (var j = 6; j < H - 22; j++) path.push([4, j]);
  for (var a = 0; a <= 60; a++) { var an = Math.PI - a/60*Math.PI, ex = (W/2 - 5), ey = 18; path.push([Math.round(W/2 + Math.cos(an)*ex), Math.round(H - 22 + Math.sin(an)*ey)]); }
  for (var j = H - 23; j >= 6; j--) path.push([W - 5, j]);
  var seen = {}, s = 0;
  path.forEach(function(p, n){
    var key = p[0] + ',' + p[1]; if (seen[key]) return; seen[key] = 1; s++;
    var st = ((s / 5) | 0), on = (s % 5) < 3; if (!on) return;
    var ri = pkThreadPick(F, st*7 + fi*101), v = 0.62 + hsh(st, fi + 9)*0.18;
    pkPx(d, W, p[0], p[1], ri, v*light); thr.push([p[0], p[1], ri]);
  });
  /* its label, stitched in: the Japanese, and the English under it. one thread, the pocket's own colour, on one
     even step of its ramp (no dither, so no banding: Aisling, Oct 24, readability first) */
  var Lj = pkLabelMask(F.jp, '600 18px ' + PK_JPFONT, 18), Le = null; for (var fz = 12; fz >= 9; fz -= 0.5) { Le = pkLabelMask(F.en, '600 ' + fz + 'px ' + PK_ENFONT, 12); if (Le.w <= W - 16) break; }   /* the English shrinks a little if it would touch the stitching (food & drink) */
  var lri = RIX[F.ink] !== undefined ? RIX[F.ink] : R_GOLD, lv = (RN[lri] - 2)/(RN[lri] - 1);
  [[Lj, 15], [Le, 41]].forEach(function(q){
    var M = q[0], ox = Math.round((W - M.w)/2), oy = q[1];
    for (var jj = 0; jj < M.h; jj++) for (var ii = 0; ii < M.w; ii++) {
      if (!M.m[jj*M.w + ii]) continue; var X = ox + ii, Y = oy + jj + 1; if (X < 0 || Y >= H || X >= W) continue;
      if (!(jj + 1 < M.h && M.m[(jj + 1)*M.w + ii])) pkPx(d, W, X, Y, R_BPLUM, 0);   /* a little shadow under each stroke */
    }
    for (var jj = 0; jj < M.h; jj++) for (var ii = 0; ii < M.w; ii++) {
      if (!M.m[jj*M.w + ii]) continue; var X = ox + ii, Y = oy + jj; if (X < 0 || Y < 0 || X >= W || Y >= H) continue;
      pkPx(d, W, X, Y, lri, lv*Math.min(1, light)); thr.push([X, Y, lri]);
    }
  });
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0);
  return { c:c, W:W, H:H, mask:mask, thr:thr };
}
/* the thread catches the light: a slow sheen sliding across each little pocket */
function pkPouchSheen(S){
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = S.W; c.height = S.H; var x = c.getContext('2d'), id = x.createImageData(S.W, S.H), d = new Uint32Array(id.data.buffer);
  S.thr.forEach(function(p){ pkPx(d, S.W, p[0], p[1], p[2], 1.0); });
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); return c;
}
/* inside a little pocket: its thread round the rim, its label under the lip */
var PK_FBG = {};
function pkFolderBg(F, fi){
  if (PK_FBG[F.id]) return PK_FBG[F.id];
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = PW; c.height = PH; var x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(POK.bgMain, 0, 0);
  var id = x.getImageData(0, 0, PW, PH), d = new Uint32Array(id.data.buffer), s = 0;
  for (var a = 0; a < 900; a++) {   /* a running stitch just inside the rim */
    var t = a/900, X, Y;
    if (t < 0.18) { X = 72; Y = 96 + t/0.18*170; } else if (t < 0.82) { var an = Math.PI - (t - 0.18)/0.64*Math.PI; X = 384 + Math.cos(an)*311; Y = 266 + Math.sin(an)*92; } else { X = 696; Y = 266 - (t - 0.82)/0.18*170; }
    X = Math.round(X); Y = Math.round(Y); s++; if (((s/6) | 0) % 2) continue;
    var st = (s/6) | 0, ri = pkThreadPick(F, st*5 + fi*19); pkPx(d, PW, X, Y, ri, 0.5 + hsh(st, fi)*0.14);
  }
  var Lj = pkLabelMask(F.jp + ' · ' + F.en, '600 13px ' + PK_JPFONT, 13), ox = Math.round((PW - Lj.w)/2), oy = 96;
  for (var jj = 0; jj < Lj.h; jj++) for (var ii = 0; ii < Lj.w; ii++) if (Lj.m[jj*Lj.w + ii]) { var run = ((ii + jj*3)/4) | 0; pkPx(d, PW, ox + ii, oy + jj, pkThreadPick(F, run*13 + jj + fi*57), 0.56 + hsh(run, jj)*0.12); }
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); PK_FBG[F.id] = c; return c;
}
