var PK_LOOSE_SLOTS = [[196, 268, -0.2], [566, 262, 0.14], [384, 236, 0.05], [290, 322, -0.1], [478, 318, 0.13], [636, 318, 0.22], [128, 316, 0.2]];
pkPages = function(){ return POK.folder ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(pkList().length/PK_PER)) : 2; };
pkLayout = function(){
  var T = POK.turn;
  if (T && T.swapped && T.fold !== undefined && !T.foldDone) { T.foldDone = true; POK.folder = T.fold; POK.page = T.np; }
  if (POK.bgMain) { var Fi = -1; PK_FOLDERS.forEach(function(F, i){ if (F.id === POK.folder) Fi = i; }); POK.bg = Fi >= 0 ? pkFolderBg(PK_FOLDERS[Fi], Fi) : POK.bgMain; }
  var L = pkList(), out = [], pages = pkPages();
  POK.page = Math.min(POK.page || 0, pages - 1); POK.pages = pages;
  if (POK.folder) {
    L.slice(POK.page*PK_PER, (POK.page + 1)*PK_PER).forEach(function(id, n){
      var s = PK_SLOTS[n], j = POK.page*7 + PK_FOLDERS.map(function(F){ return F.id; }).indexOf(POK.folder)*3;
      out.push({ id:id, x:s[0] + (hsh(n + j, 21) - 0.5)*26, y:s[1] + (hsh(n + j, 22) - 0.5)*14, rot:s[2] + (hsh(n + j, 23) - 0.5)*0.4, depth:s[3], n:n });
    });
  } else if (POK.page === 0) {
    var shown = pkFoldersShown(), gap = 10, rows = shown.length > 6 ? 2 : 1, perRow = Math.ceil(shown.length/rows);   /* (Oct 28) more than six pockets: two rows */
    shown.forEach(function(F, n0){
      var row = Math.floor(n0/perRow), n = n0 - row*perRow, inRow = row === rows - 1 ? shown.length - row*perRow : perRow;
      var tot = inRow*PK_POUCH_W + (inRow - 1)*gap, x0 = 384 - tot/2 + PK_POUCH_W/2, yRow = rows === 1 ? 142 : (row === 0 ? 110 : 196);
      var fi = PK_FOLDERS.indexOf(F); if (!POK.pouch) POK.pouch = {};
      var P = POK.pouch[F.id]; if (!P) { P = POK.pouch[F.id] = { S:pkPouchSprite(F, 1, fi), Sh:null, sheen:null }; P.Sh = pkPouchSprite(F, 1.16, fi); P.sheen = pkPouchSheen(P.S); P.sh = pkShadow(P.S); }
      out.push({ id:'pouch_' + F.id, pouch:F, x:Math.round(x0 + n*(PK_POUCH_W + gap)), y:yRow + Math.round((hsh(fi, 31) - 0.5)*6), rot:0, depth:3, n:-10 + n0, S:P.S, Sh:P.Sh, sh:P.sh, sheen:P.sheen, fi:fi });
    });
    L.forEach(function(id, n){ var s = PK_LOOSE_SLOTS[n % PK_LOOSE_SLOTS.length]; out.push({ id:id, x:s[0], y:s[1], rot:s[2], depth:n < 3 ? 0 : 1, n:n }); });
  } else {
    out.push({ id:'kodama', x:384, y:300, rot:-0.07, depth:3, deep:true, n:99 });   /* one layer down, always: too far to reach */
  }
  out.sort(function(a, b){ return b.depth - a.depth || a.n - b.n; });
  out.forEach(function(it){
    if (it.pouch) return;
    var D = PK_DEPTH[it.depth], A = PK_ART[it.id];
    it.sc = A.lie*D[0]; it.light = (it.deep ? 0.32 : D[1])*(1 - 0.08*Math.min(3, POK.page || 0));
    it.S = pkSprite(it.id, it.sc, it.rot, it.light); it.sh = it.S ? pkShadow(it.S) : null; it.Sh = null;
  });
  POK.items = out;
  pkNav();
};

/* ---- going in and out ---- */
/* the pocket's sounds (Aisling, Oct 24: "very small for the pocket and an even smaller version for the sub pocket …
   sensory friendly … tiny and subtle, but add to the sensory in a pleasant way"). made here, not recorded: soft wool
   brushing wool, low-passed so nothing is sharp, a slow start so nothing clicks, never quite the same twice, and never
   twice in a quarter second. the pocket opening is the "big" one; a little pocket is smaller and softer; coming back
   out is smaller still. (a recording of real fabric could replace these later.) */
var PK_SND = { last:0 };
function pkRustle(len, level, tone){
  var S = SND; if (!S || !S.on || !S.ctx || !S.dry) return;
  var now = performance.now(); if (now - PK_SND.last < 250) return; PK_SND.last = now;
  try {
    /* (Oct 24, v2: Aisling: "too hard, like something hard hitting, instead of soft fabric") no low end and no
       bumps now: a hand sliding over cloth. it swells in and out (no edge anywhere), a soft hiss in the middle
       frequencies, a slow uneven flutter, and a dust of very small catches, the way wool drags */
    var c = S.ctx, t = c.currentTime + 0.01, n = Math.floor(c.sampleRate*len), b = c.createBuffer(1, n, c.sampleRate), d = b.getChannelData(0);
    var fl = 0, flT = 0, cr = 0, peak = 0.38 + Math.random()*0.12;
    for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) {
      var e = i/n, env = e < peak ? Math.pow(Math.sin(e/peak*Math.PI/2), 2) : Math.pow(Math.cos((e - peak)/(1 - peak)*Math.PI/2), 2);
      if ((i & 255) === 0) flT = 0.7 + Math.random()*0.3; fl += (flT - fl)*0.0015;   /* slow, uneven flutter */
      if (Math.random() < 0.004) cr = 0.5 + Math.random()*0.5; cr *= 0.985;   /* tiny catches, each fading in a couple of ms */
      d[i] = (Math.random()*2 - 1)*env*fl*(1 + cr*0.6);
    }
    var src = c.createBufferSource(); src.buffer = b; src.playbackRate.value = tone*(0.97 + Math.random()*0.06);
    var hp = c.createBiquadFilter(); hp.type = 'highpass'; hp.frequency.value = 650*tone; hp.Q.value = 0.5;
    var lp = c.createBiquadFilter(); lp.type = 'lowpass'; lp.frequency.value = 3600*tone; lp.Q.value = 0.4;
    var lp2 = c.createBiquadFilter(); lp2.type = 'lowpass'; lp2.frequency.value = 5200; lp2.Q.value = 0.3;
    var g = c.createGain(); g.gain.value = level;
    src.connect(hp); hp.connect(lp); lp.connect(lp2); lp2.connect(g); g.connect(S.dry); src.start(t);
  } catch (e) {}
}
var PK_SND_LV = { open:0.016, into:0.0102, out:0.0079 };   /* (Oct 24) v2: matched by ear-weighted loudness (A-weighting) to the first version after it was made 5% softer */   /* set against the pickup sound: the pocket opening a touch above it, a little pocket below it, out below that */
function pkFoldSnd(open){ if (open) pkRustle(0.26, PK_SND_LV.into, 1.05); else pkRustle(0.22, PK_SND_LV.out, 0.9); }
function pkInto(F){
  if (!POK.ready || POK.lift || POK.turn) return;
  POK.turn = { t0:performance.now(), d:1, np:0, swapped:false, fold:F.id }; POK.hover = -1;
  pkCap.textContent = 'you open the little pocket.'; pkFoldSnd(true);
}
function pkOut(){
  /* (Oct 30, Aisling: "out not working on capsule toys": with a prize held up, out did nothing. now it puts the prize back down, then goes out) */
  if (POK.ready && POK.lift && !POK.turn && POK.folder) { var L = POK.lift; if (L.t1 < 0) L.t1 = performance.now(); setTimeout(pkOut, 360); return; }
  if (!POK.ready || POK.lift || POK.turn || !POK.folder) return;
  POK.turn = { t0:performance.now(), d:-1, np:0, swapped:false, fold:null }; POK.hover = -1;
  pkCap.textContent = 'you come back out.'; pkFoldSnd(false);
}

/* ================================================================
   THE CAMERAS TAKE PICTURES (Oct 29; Aisling: "i plan on having a photo developing booth in missing mile" / "and a
   film lab in another area" / "i think each roll has 36 photos")
   - the two disposables (とるんです, the green flash one) come with their roll in them: 36 pictures. take a picture
     from the pocket; when all 36 are taken the wheel won't turn, and the camera itself needs developing.
   - the pink camera takes the rolls you buy: colour 400, black and white 400, portrait 160 (36 each). load one, take
     36, it winds itself back, and the finished roll goes in your pocket, undeveloped.
   - nothing comes back yet. the pictures are kept, unseen, until the developing booth (Missing Mile) and the film lab
     (another place) exist; they'll turn a finished roll or camera into prints (doc 30).
   - a picture is what you see when you take it: the pocket closes, a soft click, the film winds on. no flash goes off
     on the screen (the flash camera's pictures will just come out flash-lit). kept small in the browser (120 × 80).
   - shared: the hub, Furusato and the line's stops all use this file (the hub keeps a copy).
   ================================================================ */
var FILM_N = 36;
var FILM = (function(){ try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('nullgrey.film') || 'null'); } catch (e) { return null; } })() || { n:0, rolls:{}, cams:{} };
var FILM_TYPES = { color:['カラー', 'colour 400', '#f0d84a', '#c8402e'], bw:['モノクロ', 'black and white 400', '#f2f0ea', '#1e1714'], portrait:['ポートレート', 'portrait 160', '#a07090', '#e8a040'] };
var FILM_ROLL_ITEMS = { f_film_color:'color', f_film_bw:'bw', f_film_portrait:'portrait' };
var FILM_DISP = { f_cam_torundesu:1, f_cam_flash:1 };
if (typeof FSND !== 'undefined') {
  FSND.cam_shutter = { kind:'one', vol:0.3, what:'(added Oct 29) a camera\'s shutter, a picture taken (under 1 s). until there is a file, a made one: a soft dry click' };
  FSND.cam_wind = { kind:'one', vol:0.26, what:'(added Oct 29) a camera wound on after a picture: the thumbwheel\'s ratchet, a few clicks (under 1 s); also a roll rewinding when it\'s finished. until there is a file, made ticks' };
}
function filmSave(){ try { localStorage.setItem('nullgrey.film', JSON.stringify(FILM)); return true; } catch (e) { return false; } }
function filmHave(id){ return typeof PK_HAVE !== 'undefined' && PK_HAVE.indexOf(id) >= 0; }
function filmNewRoll(type, cam){ var id = 'r' + (++FILM.n); FILM.rolls[id] = { id:id, film:type, cam:cam, shots:[], t:Date.now(), done:false, dev:false }; return id; }
function filmCam(id){
  var c = FILM.cams[id] || (FILM.cams[id] = { roll:null, full:false });
  if (FILM_DISP[id] && !c.roll && !c.full) { c.roll = filmNewRoll('color', id); filmSave(); }   /* a disposable: its roll is in it */
  return c;
}
function filmLeft(c){ var R = c.roll && FILM.rolls[c.roll]; return R ? FILM_N - R.shots.length : 0; }
function filmPlay(k){   /* its sound slot if there's a file; if not, a soft made one */
  try { if (typeof fSndLoaded === 'function' && fSndLoaded(k) && fSnd(k)) return; } catch (e) {}
  try { var S = SND; if (!S || !S.on || !S.ctx || !S.dry) return; var c = S.ctx, t = c.currentTime + 0.01;
    var ticks = k === 'cam_shutter' ? [[0, 0.11, 1800]] : [[0, 0.05, 3200], [0.07, 0.05, 3000], [0.14, 0.05, 3300], [0.21, 0.05, 3100]];
    ticks.forEach(function(q){ var L = Math.floor(c.sampleRate*0.02), b = c.createBuffer(1, L, c.sampleRate), d = b.getChannelData(0); for (var i = 0; i < L; i++) d[i] = (Math.random()*2 - 1)*Math.pow(1 - i/L, 5);
      var n = c.createBufferSource(), f = c.createBiquadFilter(), g = c.createGain(); n.buffer = b; f.type = 'bandpass'; f.frequency.value = q[2]; f.Q.value = 1.4; g.gain.value = q[1]; n.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(S.dry); n.start(t + q[0]); });
  } catch (e) {}
}
function filmSay(t){ try { if (typeof say === 'function') say(t, 4200); } catch (e) {} }
/* a finished roll in the pocket */

  var T = FILM_TYPES[R.film] || FILM_TYPES.color, id = 'f_roll_' + rid;
  PK_ART[id] = { vb:[26, 32], k:4.4, lie:0.24, folder:'camera', unique:true,
    cap:'a finished roll of ' + T[1] + ' film, wound back into its can. ' + R.shots.length + ' pictures you haven\'t seen yet. it needs developing.',
    svg:function(){ return '<rect x="4" y="4" width="18" height="25" rx="2" fill="#5d554e"/><rect x="4" y="9" width="18" height="15" fill="' + T[2] + '"/><rect x="4" y="9" width="18" height="4" fill="' + T[3] + '"/><rect x="10" y="1.5" width="6" height="3" fill="#3a3632"/><rect x="5" y="5" width="2" height="23" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.18"/>' +
      (typeof pkT === 'function' ? pkT(T[0], 13, 21, T[0].length > 3 ? 2.4 : 3.2, T[3] === '#1e1714' ? '#1e1714' : '#f2f0ea', { w:900 }) : ''); } };
  if (typeof FU_ITEMS !== 'undefined') FU_ITEMS[id] = { jp:T[0], en:'finished roll · ' + T[1], price:0, kind:'thing' };
}
Object.keys(FILM.rolls).forEach(function(rid){ var R = FILM.rolls[rid]; if (R.done && !R.dev && R.cam === 'f_cam_pink') filmRollArt(rid); });
/* ---- (Oct 29, evening) THE VIEWFINDER. Aisling: "should we build a very simple viewfinder for them to aim to take the
   photo a very old fashioned one but easy to see through use and light graphically and basically the same functionality".
   from the pocket: "look through it?" → the pocket closes and you look through the camera: dark round the edges, a
   bright window, thin frame lines, the frame counter under it. you can still turn and walk to aim. a click or a tap
   (or space) takes the picture of what's in the window; esc or "put it away" ends it. nothing flashes: the window
   only dims softly for a moment as the shutter goes. ---- */
var VF = { open:false, cam:null, el:null, win:null };
function vfBuild(){
  if (VF.el || typeof stage === 'undefined') return;
  var st = document.createElement('style');
  st.textContent = '#vf{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;display:none;pointer-events:none;font-family:inherit;}#vf.open{display:block;}' +
    '#vf svg{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;}' +
    '#vf .dim{transition:opacity .16s ease-out;opacity:0;}#vf.shut .dim{opacity:.5;transition:opacity .08s ease-in;}' +
    '#vf-bar{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(228,220,208,.86);}' +
    '#vf-n{font-family:monospace;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#e8a040;background:#0d0a09;border:1px solid rgba(140,137,131,.55);padding:1px 7px;min-width:22px;text-align:center;}' +
    '#vf-bar button{pointer-events:auto;font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.14em;color:rgba(228,220,208,.9);background:rgba(42,32,41,.92);border:1px solid rgba(140,137,131,.7);padding:3px 12px;cursor:pointer;}#vf-bar button:hover{background:rgba(92,74,99,.95);}';
  document.head.appendChild(st);
  var el = document.createElement('div'); el.id = 'vf';
  el.innerHTML = '<svg preserveAspectRatio="none"></svg><div id="vf-bar"><button type="button" data-a="take">撮る · take</button><span id="vf-n">36</span><button type="button" data-a="away">しまう · put it away</button></div>';
  stage.appendChild(el); VF.el = el;
  el.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('pointerdown', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); });
    b.addEventListener('click', function(e){ e.stopPropagation(); if (b.getAttribute('data-a') === 'take') filmTake(); else vfClose(); }); });
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ if (VF.open) vfLayout(); });
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){ if (!VF.open) return; var k = e.key || '';
    if (k === 'Escape') { vfClose(); e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); }
    else if (k === ' ' || k === 'Enter') { if (!e.repeat) filmTake(); e.preventDefault(); e.stopImmediatePropagation(); } }, true);
}
function vfLayout(){   /* the window: 3:2, as tall as fits with room for the counter under it */
  var r = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), W = r.width, H = r.height, cap = H*0.04 + 30, gap = 8, barH = 24, wh = Math.min(H*0.66, W*0.82/1.5, H - cap - barH - gap*3), ww = wh*1.5, x0 = (W - ww)/2, y0 = Math.max(gap, (H - cap - barH - gap - wh)/2), rr = Math.min(ww, wh)*0.06;
  VF.win = { x:x0, y:y0, w:ww, h:wh };
  var c = 'rgba(242,236,224,0.55)', L = Math.min(ww, wh)*0.09, ins = Math.min(ww, wh)*0.06, fx = x0 + ins, fy = y0 + ins, fw = ww - ins*2, fh = wh - ins*2;
  var corners = [[fx, fy, 1, 1], [fx + fw, fy, -1, 1], [fx, fy + fh, 1, -1], [fx + fw, fy + fh, -1, -1]].map(function(q){ return '<path d="M' + (q[0] + q[2]*L) + ' ' + q[1] + 'H' + q[0] + 'V' + (q[1] + q[3]*L) + '" fill="none" stroke="' + c + '" stroke-width="1.4"/>'; }).join('');
  VF.el.querySelector('svg').setAttribute('viewBox', '0 0 ' + W + ' ' + H);
  VF.el.querySelector('svg').innerHTML = '<defs><radialGradient id="vfv" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="62%"><stop offset="62%" stop-color="#0d0a09" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="100%" stop-color="#0d0a09" stop-opacity="0.55"/></radialGradient>' +
    '<mask id="vfm"><rect width="' + W + '" height="' + H + '" fill="#fff"/><rect x="' + x0 + '" y="' + y0 + '" width="' + ww + '" height="' + wh + '" rx="' + rr + '" fill="#000"/></mask></defs>' +
    '<rect width="' + W + '" height="' + H + '" fill="#120e0c" opacity="0.94" mask="url(#vfm)"/>' +   /* the camera's body round the window */
    '<rect x="' + x0 + '" y="' + y0 + '" width="' + ww + '" height="' + wh + '" rx="' + rr + '" fill="url(#vfv)"/>' +   /* the lens darkening the corners a little */
    '<rect x="' + (x0 - 2) + '" y="' + (y0 - 2) + '" width="' + (ww + 4) + '" height="' + (wh + 4) + '" rx="' + (rr + 2) + '" fill="none" stroke="#2e2622" stroke-width="3"/>' +
    corners + '<circle cx="' + (x0 + ww/2) + '" cy="' + (y0 + wh/2) + '" r="' + Math.max(5, wh*0.03) + '" fill="none" stroke="' + c + '" stroke-width="1"/>' +   /* the frame lines and the middle */
    '<rect class="dim" x="' + x0 + '" y="' + y0 + '" width="' + ww + '" height="' + wh + '" rx="' + rr + '" fill="#0d0a09"/>';   /* the shutter: a soft dip, never a flash */
  var bar = document.getElementById('vf-bar'); bar.style.top = (y0 + wh + gap) + 'px';   /* (Oct 29) just under the window, clear of the caption line even on a phone held upright */
}
function vfCount(){ var c = VF.cam && filmCam(VF.cam), n = document.getElementById('vf-n'); if (n) n.textContent = c && c.roll ? String(FILM_N - FILM.rolls[c.roll].shots.length) : '–'; }
function vfOpen(camId){
  vfBuild(); if (!VF.el) { filmTake(camId); return; }
  try { if (typeof pkClose === 'function') pkClose(); } catch (e) {}
  VF.open = true; VF.cam = camId; vfLayout(); vfCount(); VF.el.classList.add('open');
  var touch = false; try { touch = window.matchMedia('(pointer:coarse)').matches; } catch (e) {}
  filmSay(touch ? 'you look through it. tap to take a picture.' : 'you look through it. click to take a picture. (esc to put it away.)');
}
function vfClose(){ VF.open = false; if (VF.el) VF.el.classList.remove('open', 'shut'); }
if (typeof pkOpen === 'function') { var _vfPkOpen = pkOpen; pkOpen = function(){ if (VF.open) vfClose(); return _vfPkOpen.apply(this, arguments); }; }
if (typeof walkClick === 'function') { var _vfWalkClick = walkClick; walkClick = function(){ if (VF.open) { filmTake(); return; } return _vfWalkClick.apply(this, arguments); }; }   /* through the viewfinder a click takes the picture, it doesn't reach for things */
/* a picture: what's in the viewfinder's window is kept (without the viewfinder, the whole middle of the view) */
var FILM_BUSY = false;
function filmTake(camId){
  camId = camId || VF.cam; var c = filmCam(camId), R = c.roll && FILM.rolls[c.roll]; if (!R || FILM_BUSY) return;
  FILM_BUSY = true;
  if (VF.open && VF.el) { VF.el.classList.add('shut'); setTimeout(function(){ if (VF.el) VF.el.classList.remove('shut'); }, 200); }
  setTimeout(function(){
    FILM_BUSY = false; if (R.done || R.shots.length >= FILM_N) return;
    try {
      var v = document.getElementById('view'), gl = document.getElementById('glow'), W = 120, H = 80, cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = W; cv.height = H;
      var sx, sy, sw, sh;
      if (VF.open && VF.win) { var vr = v.getBoundingClientRect(), sr = stage.getBoundingClientRect(), kx = v.width/vr.width, ky = v.height/vr.height;
        sx = (sr.left + VF.win.x - vr.left)*kx; sy = (sr.top + VF.win.y - vr.top)*ky; sw = VF.win.w*kx; sh = VF.win.h*ky;
        sx = Math.max(0, sx); sy = Math.max(0, sy); sw = Math.min(v.width - sx, sw); sh = Math.min(v.height - sy, sh); }
      else { sw = Math.min(v.width, v.height*1.5); sh = v.height; sx = (v.width - sw)/2; sy = 0; }
      var x = cv.getContext('2d'); x.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; x.drawImage(v, sx, sy, sw, sh, 0, 0, W, H);
      if (gl && gl.width) { var k = gl.width/v.width; x.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen'; x.drawImage(gl, sx*k, sy*k, sw*k, sh*k, 0, 0, W, H); }
      R.shots.push({ d:cv.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.62), t:Date.now(), pg:(typeof NG_PAGE !== 'undefined' ? NG_PAGE : 'hub'), fl:camId === 'f_cam_flash' ? 1 : 0 });
    } catch (e) { R.shots.push({ d:'', t:Date.now(), pg:(typeof NG_PAGE !== 'undefined' ? NG_PAGE : 'hub') }); }
    filmPlay('cam_shutter'); setTimeout(function(){ filmPlay('cam_wind'); }, 260);
    var left = FILM_N - R.shots.length;
    if (left <= 0) {
      R.done = true; vfClose();
      if (FILM_DISP[camId]) { c.full = true; c.roll = null; filmSay('click. that was the last one. the wheel won\'t turn any more: 36 pictures inside. it needs developing.'); }
      else { c.roll = null; var rid = R.id; filmRollArt(rid);
        setTimeout(function(){ filmPlay('cam_wind'); }, 700); try { pocketPut('f_roll_' + rid); } catch (e) {}
        filmSay('click. that was the last one. the camera winds the roll back into its can. (the finished roll is in your pocket.)'); }
    } else filmSay('click. you wind it on. ' + left + ' left.');
    vfCount();
    if (!filmSave()) filmSay('click. (this camera can\'t hold any more pictures in this browser.)');
  }, 60);
}
function filmShoot(camId){ vfOpen(camId); }

FILM.bought = FILM.bought || {};
function filmStockLeft(id){ return FILM_STOCK[id] === undefined ? Infinity : Math.max(0, FILM_STOCK[id] - (FILM.bought[id] || 0)); }
if (typeof shopLeft === 'function') { var _fsLeft = shopLeft; shopLeft = function(id){ var n = _fsLeft.apply(this, arguments); return Math.min(n, filmStockLeft(id)); }; }
if (typeof pocketPut === 'function') { var _fsPut = pocketPut; pocketPut = function(id){ var ok = _fsPut.apply(this, arguments); if (ok && FILM_STOCK[id] !== undefined && typeof SHOP !== 'undefined' && SHOP.open) { FILM.bought[id] = (FILM.bought[id] || 0) + 1; filmSave(); } return ok; }; }

      if (c.full) return cap0 + ' all 36 pictures taken. it needs developing.';

      return cap0 + (disp ? '' : ' it\'s empty.'); } });
    Object.defineProperty(A, 'use', { configurable:true, get:function(){ var c = filmCam(id);
      if (c.full) return undefined;
      if (c.roll) return 'look through it? (' + filmLeft(c) + ' left)';
      return (!disp && nextFilm()) ? 'load a roll of film?' : undefined; } });
    Object.defineProperty(A, 'yes', { configurable:true, get:function(){ var c = filmCam(id); return c.roll ? '' : 'you load it.'; } });

      if (typeof pkCap !== 'undefined') pkCap.textContent = 'you load the ' + FILM_TYPES[FILM_ROLL_ITEMS[f]][1] + ' film and wind it on. 36 pictures.'; };

  Object.keys(FILM_ROLL_ITEMS).forEach(function(id){ var A = PK_ART[id]; if (!A) return; A.cap = String(A.cap || '') + (filmHave('f_cam_pink') ? ' it fits the pink camera.' : ''); });

pkLiftFrame = function(now, L){

  var x = pkCx, it = L.it, M = POK.maps[it.id]; if (!M) return;
  var big = Math.min(1, 300/M.h, (A.liftW || 300)/M.w);
  var e = L.t1 >= 0 ? 1 - pkEase(Math.min(1, (now - L.t1)/320)) : pkEase(Math.min(1, (now - L.t0)/320));

  var g = x.createRadialGradient(PKX, PKY, 10, PKX, PKY, 260); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(228,220,208,' + (0.09*e).toFixed(3) + ')'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(228,220,208,0)'); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, PW, PH);
  /* turning over: the width closes to nothing, the other side opens */
  var fs = 1, fp = 0;
  if (L.flipT0) { fp = Math.min(1, (now - L.flipT0)/360); fs = Math.abs(Math.cos(fp*Math.PI)); if (fp >= 0.5 && !L.flipSwapped) { L.flipSwapped = true; L.back = !L.back; } if (fp >= 1) { L.flipT0 = 0; L.flipSwapped = false; } }

  var cx = it.x + (PKX - it.x)*e, cy = it.y + (PKY - it.y)*e, sc = it.sc + (big - it.sc)*e, rot = it.rot*(1 - e);
  if (!L.S || L.Sk !== sc || L.Sv !== vid || e < 1) { L.S = pkSprite(vid, sc, rot, 1.02*Math.max(it.light, e)); L.Sk = sc; L.Sv = vid; }

  /* the tilt: toward the pointer, a little, as if it's in your fingers */

  L.tx = (L.tx || 0) + (tx - (L.tx || 0))*0.12; L.ty = (L.ty || 0) + (ty - (L.ty || 0))*0.12;
  var kx = fs, ky = 1;   /* (Oct 30, Aisling: prizes and the coin went "wavy" when touched and flipped: the tilt squeezed and slanted the pixels by fractions, so their rows and columns rippled. now it never warps; the tilt shows only in the sheen sliding over it, and only the flip squeezes it, for a moment) */

  if (e >= 1 && !L.done) { L.done = true; setTextDeir(pkCap, L.back ? (A.backCap || 'the back. ウキヨ玩具 · ukiyo toys.') : (A.liftCap || A.cap)); }

  var A = PK_ART[id]; if (!A) return; cv.width = 40; cv.height = 40;
  var img = new Image(); img.onload = function(){ var c = cv.getContext('2d'); c.drawImage(img, 0, 0, 40, 40); var im = c.getImageData(0, 0, 40, 40), d = im.data; for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { if (d[i + 3] < 120) { d[i + 3] = 0; continue; } var q = pkInk(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); d[i] = q[2]; d[i + 1] = q[3]; d[i + 2] = q[4]; d[i + 3] = 255; } c.putImageData(im, 0, 0); };
  img.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 40 40" width="40" height="40">' + A.svg() + '</svg>');
}

function gcCertificate(){
  var W = 1200, H = 850, c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = H; var x = c.getContext('2d');
  x.fillStyle = '#e8dcc4'; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (var i = 0; i < 9000; i++) { x.fillStyle = 'rgba(94,70,82,' + (Math.random()*0.05).toFixed(3) + ')'; x.fillRect(Math.random()*W, Math.random()*H, 2, 2); }
  x.strokeStyle = '#8a5240'; x.lineWidth = 6; x.strokeRect(36, 36, W - 72, H - 72); x.strokeStyle = '#c9a067'; x.lineWidth = 2; x.strokeRect(54, 54, W - 108, H - 108);
  x.textAlign = 'center'; x.fillStyle = '#1e1714';
  x.font = '600 26px "IBM Plex Sans JP",sans-serif'; x.fillText('ウキヨ・カプセル玩具協会', W/2, 130);
  x.font = '18px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillStyle = '#5e4652'; x.fillText('the ukiyo capsule toy association', W/2, 160);
  x.fillStyle = '#9a2a22'; x.font = '700 64px "IBM Plex Sans JP",sans-serif'; x.fillText('全種コンプリート', W/2, 270);
  x.fillStyle = '#1e1714'; x.font = '24px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillText('certificate of complete set', W/2, 310);
  x.font = '19px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillStyle = '#4f4740';
  ['this is to certify that the bearer has collected every capsule toy', 'in all seven series of the furusato line, including the secrets,', 'and has not traded, duplicated, or eaten any of them.'].forEach(function(l, i){ x.fillText(l, W/2, 380 + i*32); });
  x.font = '600 20px "IBM Plex Sans JP",sans-serif'; x.fillStyle = '#5e4652';
  F_GACHA.forEach(function(S, i){ x.fillText(S.jp, 220 + i*126, 530); });
  x.font = '13px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; F_GACHA.forEach(function(S, i){ x.fillText(S.en, 220 + i*126, 552); });
  var d = new Date(); x.textAlign = 'left'; x.font = '18px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillStyle = '#1e1714';
  x.fillText('date · ' + d.getFullYear() + '.' + (d.getMonth() + 1) + '.' + d.getDate(), 120, 690);
  x.fillText('passport · № ' + (KASSA && KASSA.pass ? String(new Date(KASSA.pass).getTime()) : '__________'), 120, 722);
  x.fillText('stamp · 調整中 slot excepted', 120, 754);
  x.save(); x.translate(W - 230, 700); x.rotate(-0.18); x.strokeStyle = '#b8433b'; x.lineWidth = 6; x.beginPath(); x.arc(0, 0, 78, 0, Math.PI*2); x.stroke(); x.lineWidth = 2; x.beginPath(); x.arc(0, 0, 66, 0, Math.PI*2); x.stroke();
  x.fillStyle = '#b8433b'; x.textAlign = 'center'; x.font = '700 54px "IBM Plex Sans JP",serif'; x.fillText('完', 0, 18); x.font = '10px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillText('UKIYO · CAPSULE', 0, 40); x.restore();
  try { var a = document.createElement('a'); a.download = 'ukiyo-capsule-certificate.png'; a.href = c.toDataURL('image/png'); document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); document.getElementById('gca-note').textContent = 'the certificate. it\'s saved to your downloads.'; } catch (e) {}
  return c;
}

(function(){

/* ---- (Oct 30) the prizes, joined up (Aisling: "can we make the gacha prizes as cute and simple and bubbly, but make them
   connect a little better with linework and such and add some details … there are still gaps"). every prize keeps its
   drawing, and is now drawn with: a soft dark outline round the whole thing (so its pieces read as one object, and the
   small gaps between them close up), a rounded shade toward its lower right and a light toward its upper left (so it
   looks plump), and a small shine. the outline is the station's dark brown, never black. ---- */
(function(){
  if (typeof PK_ART === 'undefined') return;
  Object.keys(PK_ART).forEach(function(k){
    if (!/^f_gc_/.test(k)) return; var A = PK_ART[k]; if (!A || typeof A.svg !== 'function' || A._lined) return; A._lined = true;
    var old = A.svg, w = A.vb[0], h = A.vb[1], m = Math.max(w, h), r = (m*0.022).toFixed(2), id = 'gl' + k.replace(/\W/g, '');
    A.svg = function(){ var art = old.apply(this, arguments);
      return '<defs><filter id="' + id + '" x="-8%" y="-8%" width="116%" height="116%">' +
        '<feMorphology in="SourceAlpha" operator="dilate" radius="' + r + '" result="d"/><feGaussianBlur in="d" stdDeviation="' + (m*0.004).toFixed(2) + '" result="db"/><feFlood flood-color="#2a1d1b"/><feComposite in2="db" operator="in" result="ol"/>' +
        '<feMorphology in="SourceGraphic" operator="dilate" radius="' + (m*0.006).toFixed(2) + '" result="fill"/>' +
        '<feMerge><feMergeNode in="ol"/><feMergeNode in="fill"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>' +
        '<linearGradient id="' + id + 'g" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#fff8ee" stop-opacity="0.22"/><stop offset="0.45" stop-color="#fff8ee" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="0.75" stop-color="#1e1412" stop-opacity="0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#1e1412" stop-opacity="0.3"/></linearGradient>' +
        '<filter id="' + id + 's"><feFlood flood-color="#fff"/><feComposite in2="SourceAlpha" operator="in"/></filter>' +
        '<mask id="' + id + 'm"><g filter="url(#' + id + 's)">' + art + '</g></mask></defs>' +
        '<g filter="url(#' + id + ')">' + art + '</g>' +
        '<rect width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '" fill="url(#' + id + 'g)" mask="url(#' + id + 'm)"/>';
    };
  });
})();

/* ================================================================
   THE STICKERS (Oct 26). shared: both pages.
   Aisling: "ill design real stickers and stuff that the player can collect download and print out!"
   "stickers can go in a sticker book inside your pocket … they can download and print from there".
   - four series, one per window of the arcade's sticker machine (きらきらシール, Furusato's arcade).
   - EVERY STICKER HERE IS A STAND-IN (仮) until Aisling's real ones come. to put a real one in, give its entry a
     png: a data URL (a PNG with a see-through background; about 600 × 600 px, so it prints 2 inches across at 300 dpi).
     the stand-in drawing is used only while there is no png.
   - an entry: [id, japanese name, english name, the stand-in drawing (svg inside a 0 0 40 40 box)]
     and, later, png:'data:image/png;base64,…' on a series item (F_STK_PNG[id] = '…').

var F_STK_PNG = {};   /* Aisling's real stickers go here, by id: F_STK_PNG.hoshi1 = 'data:image/png;base64,…' */
/* a stand-in sticker: the drawing with a fat white die-cut edge round it */
function fStkCut(inner){ return '<g stroke="#ffffff" stroke-width="5" stroke-linejoin="round" fill="#ffffff">' + inner.replace(/fill="[^"]*"/g, 'fill="#ffffff"').replace(/stroke="[^"]*"/g, 'stroke="#ffffff"') + '</g>' + inner; }
function fStkStar(cx, cy, r, c){ var p = ''; for (var i = 0; i < 10; i++) { var a = -Math.PI/2 + i*Math.PI/5, q = i % 2 ? r*0.45 : r; p += (i ? 'L' : 'M') + (cx + Math.cos(a)*q).toFixed(2) + ',' + (cy + Math.sin(a)*q).toFixed(2); } return '<path d="' + p + 'Z" fill="' + c + '"/>'; }
function fStkHeart(cx, cy, r, c){ return '<path d="M' + cx + ',' + (cy + r*0.9) + ' C' + (cx - r*1.6) + ',' + (cy - r*0.1) + ' ' + (cx - r*0.9) + ',' + (cy - r*1.3) + ' ' + cx + ',' + (cy - r*0.45) + ' C' + (cx + r*0.9) + ',' + (cy - r*1.3) + ' ' + (cx + r*1.6) + ',' + (cy - r*0.1) + ' ' + cx + ',' + (cy + r*0.9) + ' Z" fill="' + c + '"/>'; }

/* ================================================================
   THE STICKER BOOK IN THE POCKET (Oct 26). shared: both pages.

   print from there".
   - a little pocket of its own, シール · stickers, sewn in once you have your first sticker. the sticker book lies in it.
   - tap the book: it opens. a page per series (one per window of the machine); what you have, stuck on the page,
     with how many; what you don't, a dashed outline. every sticker you have can be saved as a PNG (see-through

/* the album's own inks in the pocket: the usual ones and the pinks and golds (the pocket's own inks would turn its pinks lilac, which leans blue) */
var PK_INKS_STK = null, PK_INKC_STK = {};
function pkInkStk(r, g, b){
  if (!PK_INKS_STK) { PK_INKS_STK = PK_INKS.slice(); ['hglrose', 'hglgold', 'hglgreen'].forEach(function(nm){ var ri = RIX[nm]; if (ri === undefined) return; var n = RN[ri]; for (var k = 0; k < n; k++) { var c = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + k]; PK_INKS_STK.push([ri, (k + 0.5)/n, c & 255, (c >> 8) & 255, (c >> 16) & 255]); } }); }
  var key = (r >> 2) << 12 | (g >> 2) << 6 | (b >> 2), c = PK_INKC_STK[key]; if (c) return c; var best = null, bd = 1e9;
  for (var k = 0; k < PK_INKS_STK.length; k++) { var q = PK_INKS_STK[k], dr = r - q[2], dg = g - q[3], db = b - q[4], d = dr*dr*0.3 + dg*dg*0.59 + db*db*0.11; if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = q; } }
  PK_INKC_STK[key] = best; return best;
}

function stkSaveOne(id){

}
/* letter-size sheets (8.5 × 11 in at 300 dpi) of everything you have: 2-inch stickers, 3 across, 4 down, a faint grey
   line round each white edge to cut along; more than 12, more sheets */
function stkSheet(){
  var ids = fStkAll().filter(function(E){ return stkHave(E.id); }).map(function(E){ return E.id; }); if (!ids.length) return;
  var pages = Math.ceil(ids.length/12), pg = 0;
  (function sheet(){
    if (pg >= pages) { document.getElementById('stb-note').textContent = (pages > 1 ? pages + ' sheets are' : 'the sheet is') + ' saved to your downloads. print at 100% (no "fit to page") on sticker paper.'; return; }
    var W = 2550, H = 3300, c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = H; var x = c.getContext('2d');
    x.fillStyle = '#ffffff'; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
    x.fillStyle = '#cc4a8c'; x.textAlign = 'center'; x.font = '700 60px "IBM Plex Sans JP",sans-serif'; x.fillText('きらきらシール', W/2, 160); x.font = '32px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillText('null.grey · furusato line · sparkle stickers' + (pages > 1 ? ' · ' + (pg + 1) + '/' + pages : ''), W/2, 212);
    var L = ids.slice(pg*12, pg*12 + 12), n = 0, cw = 760, ch = 700, ox = (W - 3*cw)/2, oy = 270;
    (function next(){
      if (n >= L.length) { x.fillStyle = '#b8a8ae'; x.textAlign = 'center'; x.font = '28px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; x.fillText('print at 100% on sticker paper. cut along the grey line.', W/2, H - 70); stkDownload(c, 'null-grey-sticker-sheet' + (pages > 1 ? '-' + (pg + 1) : '') + '.png'); pg++; setTimeout(sheet, 400); return; }
      var id = L[n], col = n % 3, row = (n/3) | 0;
      stkDraw(id, 600, function(img){
        var X = ox + col*cw + 80, Y = oy + row*ch + 20;
        if (img) { try { x.filter = 'drop-shadow(0 0 1.5px #9a9a9a)'; } catch (e) {} x.drawImage(img, X, Y, 600, 600); try { x.filter = 'none'; } catch (e) {} }
        var E = fStkFind(id); x.fillStyle = '#8a6a78'; x.textAlign = 'center'; x.font = '26px "IBM Plex Sans JP",sans-serif'; x.fillText(E ? E.I[1] + ' · ' + E.I[2] : id, ox + col*cw + cw/2, Y + 640);
        n++; next(); });
    })();
  })();
}

/* ---- (Oct 30, Aisling) the booth's third strip: "the third is static and binary code, and maybe c++ weirdness ...
   glitchy odd ... when you see it in close up before it goes in your pocket its alive creepy ... not fun ...
   unsettling. then the photo booth breaks". the frames are you, eaten by static; numbers where your face was; lines
   of code that shouldn't be in a photograph. t: a step of its slow crawl (the close-up moves it; the pocket keeps one) ---- */
function boothGlitchSvg(t){
  t = t || 0;
  var s = '<rect width="40" height="112" fill="#d6d5d1"/>', K = ['#5d554e', '#8c8983', '#bdbab3', '#30302f', '#e5e4e0'];
  for (var f = 0; f < 4; f++) {
    var y0 = 3 + f*26, sd = f*97 + t*13;
    s += '<rect x="3" y="' + y0 + '" width="34" height="24" fill="#8c8983"/>';
    for (var i = 0; i < 70; i++) { var h = hsh(i + sd, f*7 + (t % 9)); s += '<rect x="' + (3 + hsh(i*3 + sd, 5)*32).toFixed(1) + '" y="' + (y0 + hsh(i*5, sd + 2)*23).toFixed(1) + '" width="' + (0.6 + h*2.2).toFixed(1) + '" height="0.6" fill="' + K[(i + f + t) % 5] + '"/>'; }   /* static */
    if (f < 3) {   /* you, coming apart: the shoulders still there, the head a block of numbers that turns a little more each frame */
      var tx = 20 + (f - 1)*2 + Math.sin(t*0.7 + f)*0.6;
      s += '<path d="M' + (tx - 10) + ',' + (y0 + 24) + ' Q' + tx + ',' + (y0 + 15) + ' ' + (tx + 10) + ',' + (y0 + 24) + ' Z" fill="#4f4740"/>';
      s += '<rect x="' + (tx - 5) + '" y="' + (y0 + 5) + '" width="10" height="10" fill="#30302f"/>';
      for (var r = 0; r < 4; r++) { var bits = ''; for (var b = 0; b < 4; b++) bits += hsh(b + r*4 + sd, t + f) > 0.5 ? '1' : '0';
        s += '<text x="' + tx + '" y="' + (y0 + 7.4 + r*2.4) + '" text-anchor="middle" font-family="IBM Plex Mono,monospace" font-size="2.2" fill="#bdbab3">' + bits + '</text>'; }

/* the paper: squared exercise-book paper (grey-plum lines, no blue), a red margin, the torn edge where it left the
   book, the creases of being folded in four, and the soft wrinkles of being carried */
function knPaper(){
  var c = document.getElementById('knv'), x = c.getContext('2d'), W = 640, H = 460, rnd = (function(s){ return function(){ s = (s*16807) % 2147483647; return s/2147483647; }; })(1022);
  x.clearRect(0, 0, W, H);
  x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(14, 6);   /* the outline: its left edge torn out of the book */
  for (var y = 6; y <= H - 6; y += 6) x.lineTo(6 + rnd()*9, y);
  x.lineTo(W - 8, H - 4); x.lineTo(W - 4, 4); x.closePath();
  x.fillStyle = '#efe8d8'; x.fill(); x.save(); x.clip();
  var g = x.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, H); g.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,250,240,0.25)'); g.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(140,120,90,0.12)'); x.fillStyle = g; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(150,135,148,0.45)'; x.lineWidth = 1;
  for (var gx = 18; gx < W; gx += 19) { x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(gx + 0.5, 0); x.lineTo(gx + 1.5, H); x.stroke(); }
  for (var gy = 14; gy < H; gy += 19) { x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(0, gy + 0.5); x.lineTo(W, gy - 0.5); x.stroke(); }
  x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(196,80,68,0.75)'; x.lineWidth = 1.6; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(W - 108, 0); x.lineTo(W - 106, H); x.stroke();   /* the margin */
  /* the creases: folded in half, then in half again */
  [[W/2 + 4, 0, W/2 - 2, H, 'v'], [0, H/2 + 3, W, H/2 - 4, 'h']].forEach(function(f){
    for (var k = -4; k <= 4; k++) { var a = 0.16*(1 - Math.abs(k)/5); x.strokeStyle = k < 0 ? 'rgba(90,70,50,' + a + ')' : 'rgba(255,252,245,' + a*1.6 + ')'; x.lineWidth = 1; x.beginPath(); if (f[4] === 'v') { x.moveTo(f[0] + k, f[1]); x.lineTo(f[2] + k, f[3]); } else { x.moveTo(f[0], f[1] + k); x.lineTo(f[2], f[3] + k); } x.stroke(); }
  });
  /* the wrinkles: short soft creases every which way, darker on one side, lighter on the other */
  for (var w = 0; w < 46; w++) { var cx = rnd()*W, cy = rnd()*H, an = rnd()*Math.PI, ln = 20 + rnd()*90, dx = Math.cos(an)*ln, dy = Math.sin(an)*ln;
    x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(100,80,60,' + (0.05 + rnd()*0.07) + ')'; x.lineWidth = 1.2; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(cx, cy); x.quadraticCurveTo(cx + dx/2 + (rnd() - 0.5)*20, cy + dy/2 + (rnd() - 0.5)*20, cx + dx, cy + dy); x.stroke();
    x.strokeStyle = 'rgba(255,252,245,' + (0.12 + rnd()*0.12) + ')'; x.lineWidth = 1; x.beginPath(); x.moveTo(cx + 1.5, cy + 1.5); x.quadraticCurveTo(cx + dx/2 + 1.5, cy + dy/2 + 1.5, cx + dx + 1.5, cy + dy + 1.5); x.stroke(); }

   as the other vending machines, but not a beep for the button push i think it would just have the same sounds as
   platform one buttons and machine")
   Main Street borrows Furusato's machine close-up (f6x-vend.js) as it is. This page has no shop of its own, so this
   file gives it the few things f6x asks for (its sound slots, how many are left, the names), before f6x loads. the
   sounds are Platform 1's: its heavy button (vend_btn1, the hub's v_btn1), the coin, the whirr, the drop, the change,
   the flap. no ピポ.
   ================================================================ */

/* ================================================================
   f6x — THE VENDING MACHINES UP CLOSE (Oct 27; Aisling: "the function of the vending machine and views should match
   the hub and station one, just the aesthetics are different. But the ticket thing for ramen should stay the same.")
   the Smile Soda machine and the two tobacco machines now work the way №333 does in the hub (doc 19): the machine drawn
   big, taller than the screen (drag, scroll or the arrow keys to look up and down it). press the button under a thing →
   the money is somehow in your pocket → coins drop one by one, the display counts down, the machine shudders → it falls
   into the tray; push the flap and it's in your pocket. three of each a visit (the same count the old panel kept), the

FSND.vend_hum = { kind:'one', vol:0.035, what:'a vending machine working as it drops something: a short low whirr, very quiet (Oct 27: the hub\'s v_rumble, copied over, at the hub\'s soft level)' };

function fvmClick(){   /* the stand-in button: a soft plastic click, then ピポ, two little sine notes (C7, E7), quiet and short */
  var S = SND; if (!S || !S.on || !S.ctx || !S.dry) return;
  try { var c = S.ctx, t = c.currentTime + 0.01, L = Math.floor(c.sampleRate*0.015), b = c.createBuffer(1, L, c.sampleRate), d = b.getChannelData(0); for (var i = 0; i < L; i++) d[i] = (Math.random()*2 - 1)*Math.pow(1 - i/L, 4);
    var n = c.createBufferSource(), f = c.createBiquadFilter(), g = c.createGain(); n.buffer = b; f.type = 'bandpass'; f.frequency.value = 2800; f.Q.value = 1.2; g.gain.value = 0.12; n.connect(f); f.connect(g); g.connect(S.dry); n.start(t);
    [[2093, 0.03], [2637, 0.11]].forEach(function(q){ var o = c.createOscillator(), e = c.createGain(), t0 = t + q[1]; o.type = 'sine'; o.frequency.value = q[0]; e.gain.setValueAtTime(0, t0); e.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(0.045, t0 + 0.008); e.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0008, t0 + 0.09); o.connect(e); e.connect(S.dry); o.start(t0); o.stop(t0 + 0.1); });
  } catch (e) {}
}
function fvmSnd(k){ try { if (k === 'btn') { if (!fSnd('vend_btn')) fvmClick(); } else if (k === 'coin') { if (!fSnd('vend_coin')) fSnd('coin', 0.8); } else if (k === 'drop') { if (!fSnd('vend_drop')) fSnd('shop_thunk'); } else fSnd('vend_' + k); } catch (e) {} }

function fvmCap(t){ document.getElementById('fvm-cap').textContent = t; }

/* the scene: the machine at K px a unit, the wall behind it, its neighbour's edge, the floor; put through the inks */
function fvmScene(w){
  var D = FVM_DEFS[w], P = FPIC[D.pic], K = D.K, mw = P.vbw*K, mh = P.vbh*K, MX = Math.round((320 - mw)/2), MY = 22, H = Math.ceil(MY + mh + 22);
  var s = '<rect width="320" height="' + H + '" fill="#cfcac0"/>';
  for (var y = 0; y < H - 22; y += 14) for (var x = (y/14 % 2)*7; x < 320; x += 14) s += '<rect x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" width="13.4" height="13.4" fill="#dcd8d0"/>';   /* the back wall's tiles */
  s += '<rect y="' + (MY + mh) + '" width="320" height="22" fill="#8e877c"/><rect y="' + (MY + mh) + '" width="320" height="2" fill="#6c6560"/>';   /* the floor */
  s += '<rect x="' + (MX + mw) + '" y="' + (MY + 6) + '" width="10" height="' + (mh - 6) + '" fill="#000" opacity="0.16"/><ellipse cx="' + (MX + mw/2) + '" cy="' + (MY + mh + 2) + '" rx="' + (mw/2 + 8) + '" ry="5" fill="#000" opacity="0.28"/>';   /* its shadow on the wall and the floor */
  if (D.side) { var nx = D.side === 'smokes2' ? MX - mw - 0.02*K*100 : MX + mw + 0.02*K*100;   /* (facing them, the east one is on the left) */ s += '<g transform="translate(' + nx + ' ' + MY + ') scale(' + K + ')">' + FPIC[FVM_DEFS[D.side].pic].svg() + '</g><rect x="' + nx + '" y="' + MY + '" width="' + mw + '" height="' + mh + '" fill="#0a0908" opacity="0.32"/>'; }
  s += '<g transform="translate(' + MX + ' ' + MY + ') scale(' + K + ')">' + P.svg();
  /* its edges: the steel case's rounded corners catching the light on the left, in shade on the right */
  s += '<rect x="0" y="0" width="1.2" height="' + P.vbh + '" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.22"/><rect x="' + (P.vbw - 1.6) + '" y="0" width="1.6" height="' + P.vbh + '" fill="#000" opacity="0.22"/>';
  /* the glass: a soft sheen, scuffs round the buttons */
  var W = D.win; s += '<path d="M' + W[0] + ',' + (W[1] + W[3]*0.5) + ' L' + (W[0] + W[2]*0.45) + ',' + W[1] + ' L' + (W[0] + W[2]*0.62) + ',' + W[1] + ' L' + W[0] + ',' + (W[1] + W[3]*0.78) + ' Z" fill="#ffffff" opacity="0.07"/>';
  D.slots.forEach(function(q, i){ if (q.btn) s += '<ellipse cx="' + (q.btn[0] + q.btn[2]/2) + '" cy="' + (q.btn[1] + q.btn[3]/2) + '" rx="' + (q.btn[2]*0.9) + '" ry="' + (q.btn[3]*0.9) + '" fill="#8a8076" opacity="' + (0.08 + (i*7 % 5)*0.03) + '"/>'; });
  return { svg:s + '</g>', K:K, MX:MX, MY:MY, W:320, H:H, mh:mh };
}
function fvmBuild(w){
  if (FVM.sc[w]) return;
  var Q = fvmScene(w), img = new Image(); FVM.sc[w] = { K:Q.K, MX:Q.MX, MY:Q.MY, H:Q.H, c:null };
  img.onload = function(){
    var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 320; c.height = Q.H; var x = c.getContext('2d'); x.drawImage(img, 0, 0);
    try { var im = x.getImageData(0, 0, 320, Q.H), d = im.data; for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { var q = pkInk(d[i], d[i + 1], d[i + 2]); d[i] = q[2]; d[i + 1] = q[3]; d[i + 2] = q[4]; } x.putImageData(im, 0, 0); } catch (e) {}
    FVM.sc[w].c = c;
  };
  img.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent('<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 320 ' + Q.H + '" width="320" height="' + Q.H + '">' + Q.svg + '</svg>');
}
function fvmClamp(v){ var S = FVM.sc[FVM.w]; return S ? Math.max(0, Math.min(S.H - 180, v)) : 0; }
function fvmHit(e){
  var S = FVM.sc[FVM.w], D = FVM_DEFS[FVM.w], R = e.target.getBoundingClientRect(); if (!S) return null;
  var vx = ((e.clientX - R.left)/R.width*320 - S.MX)/S.K, vy = ((e.clientY - R.top)/R.height*180 + FVM.viewY - S.MY)/S.K;
  FVM.hx = vx; FVM.hy = vy;
  for (var i = 0; i < D.slots.length; i++) { var q = D.slots[i]; if (vx >= q.x && vx <= q.x + q.w && vy >= q.y && vy <= q.y + q.h) return q; }
  return null;
}
function fvmLabel(q){
  if (q.id === '_out' || q.id === '_so') return '売切 · sold out';
  if (SHOP_ONCE[q.id]) return '"' + F_MYSTERY[['f_mys_book', 'f_mys_robot', 'f_mys_tickets'].indexOf(q.id)].join(' ') + '"  · ' + shopName(q.id).price + ' д';
  var n = shopName(q.id); return n.jp + ' · ' + n.en + ' · ' + n.price + ' д' + (shopLeft(q.id) > 0 ? '' : ' · 売切');
}
function fvmClickAt(e){
  var q = fvmHit(e), D = FVM_DEFS[FVM.w], x = FVM.hx, y = FVM.hy, inR = function(r){ return r && x >= r[0] - 1 && x <= r[0] + r[2] + 1 && y >= r[1] - 1 && y <= r[1] + r[3] + 1; };
  if (q) { fvmBuy(q); return; }
  if (inR(D.tray)) { fvmFlap(); return; }
  if (inR(D.coin)) { FVM.shake = performance.now() + 120; fvmCap('you jiggle the coin return. nothing comes back.'); return; }
  if (inR(D.note)) { fvmCap('千円札 · the note slot. it doesn\'t want your notes. it never has.'); return; }
}
function fvmBuy(q){
  if (FVM.busy) return;
  var D = FVM_DEFS[FVM.w], i = D.slots.indexOf(q);
  FVM.press = { i:i, t:performance.now() }; fvmSnd('btn');
  if (q.id === '_out' || q.id === '_so') { FVM.disp = '--'; fvmCap(D.out); setTimeout(function(){ FVM.disp = ''; }, 1400); return; }
  if (shopLeft(q.id) <= 0) { FVM.disp = '--'; fvmCap(SHOP_ONCE[q.id] ? 'there was only ever one of those.' : '売切 · sold out. (it comes back next visit.)'); setTimeout(function(){ FVM.disp = ''; }, 1400); return; }
  if (FVM.flap) { fvmCap('there\'s already something in the tray.'); return; }
  var price = shopName(q.id).price;
  FVM.busy = true; FVM.disp = '' + price;
  fvmCap(FVM.first ? 'you search your pocket. you don’t know how, but the money is there.' : 'the money is there.'); FVM.first = false;
  setTimeout(function(){
    var left = price;
    (function drop(){ if (!FVM.open) { FVM.busy = false; return; } FVM.coin = performance.now(); fvmSnd('coin'); setTimeout(function(){ left--; FVM.disp = left > 0 ? '' + left : '0'; if (left > 0) setTimeout(drop, 160); else paid(); }, 260); })();
  }, 700);
  function paid(){
    FVM.shake = performance.now() + 650; fvmSnd('hum');
    setTimeout(function(){
      SHOP.got[q.id] = (SHOP.got[q.id] || 0) + 1;
      FVM.fall = { x:q.x + q.w/2, y:q.y + q.h*0.4, t0:performance.now(), col:q.col };
      setTimeout(function(){
        FVM.fall = null; FVM.shake = performance.now() + 180; fvmSnd('drop'); setTimeout(function(){ fvmSnd('change'); }, 240);
        FVM.flap = q.id; FVM.busy = false; FVM.disp = ''; FVM.viewT = fvmClamp(1e4);
        fvmCap((SHOP_ONCE[q.id] ? 'something wrapped in brown paper' : shopName(q.id).en) + '. something dropped into the tray. (push the flap)');
      }, 900);
    }, 700);
  }
}
function fvmFlap(){
  if (!FVM.flap) { fvmSnd('flap'); fvmCap('the flap swings. nothing inside.'); return; }
  var id = FVM.flap; FVM.flap = null; FVM.flapT = performance.now(); fvmSnd('flap');
  setTimeout(function(){ var ok = pocketPut(id); fvmCap(ok ? '(' + (SHOP_ONCE[id] ? 'a brown-paper package' : shopName(id).en) + ' · it\'s in your pocket now.)' : 'you already have one. you leave it for someone else.'); }, 500);
}
function fvmFrame(now){
  if (!FVM.open) return; FVM.raf = requestAnimationFrame(fvmFrame);
  var cv = document.getElementById('fvmv'), g = cv.getContext('2d'), S = FVM.sc[FVM.w], D = FVM_DEFS[FVM.w];
  if (cv.width !== 320*(FVM.hi || 1)) { cv.width = 320*(FVM.hi || 1); cv.height = 180*(FVM.hi || 1); }
  g.setTransform(FVM.hi || 1, 0, 0, FVM.hi || 1, 0, 0); g.imageSmoothingEnabled = false; g.fillStyle = '#0a0908'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);
  if (!S || !S.c) return;
  FVM.viewY += (FVM.viewT - FVM.viewY)*0.18;
  var sh = now < FVM.shake ? Math.round(Math.sin(now*0.09)*1.4) : 0, Y0 = -Math.round(FVM.viewY);
  g.drawImage(S.c, sh, Y0, 320, S.c.height/(S.hi || 1));   /* (Oct 31: the scene is drawn at three times the pixels, f7f) */
  function V(x, y){ return [S.MX + x*S.K + sh, S.MY + y*S.K + Y0]; }
  /* the lit window: a soft glow off the glass, very slowly breathing */
  var W = D.win, a = V(W[0], W[1]); g.save(); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'; g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,236,200,' + (0.05 + 0.012*Math.sin(now/2600)) + ')'; g.fillRect(a[0], a[1], W[2]*S.K, W[3]*S.K); g.restore();
  /* the display */
  var d0 = V(D.disp[0], D.disp[1]), dw = D.disp[2]*S.K, dh = D.disp[3]*S.K;
  g.fillStyle = '#121211'; g.fillRect(Math.round(d0[0]), Math.round(d0[1]), Math.round(dw), Math.round(dh));
  g.fillStyle = '#e0a040'; g.font = '900 ' + Math.round(dh*0.78) + 'px "IBM Plex Mono",monospace'; g.textBaseline = 'middle'; g.textAlign = 'right';
  g.fillText(FVM.disp || '0', Math.round(d0[0] + dw - 2), Math.round(d0[1] + dh/2 + 1));
  g.textAlign = 'left';
  /* a pressed button lights */
  if (FVM.press && now - FVM.press.t < 260) { var q = D.slots[FVM.press.i], b = q.btn || [q.x + q.w/2 - 2, q.y + q.h - 2, 4, 1.6], p = V(b[0], b[1]); g.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,220,150,0.55)'; g.fillRect(p[0] - 1, p[1] - 1, b[2]*S.K + 2, b[3]*S.K + 2); }
  /* a coin going in */

/* ================================================================
   THE TAGS. easter eggs: the tags Aisling and her friends used to write —
   sky · PLUR · Rain · Faint · Sin · Faust · tabb. small, in odd corners,
   almost hidden. Faint is hers (so: Null Aisling / Constant / Blue's).
   no graffiti font can be counted on offline, so each tag is drawn here as
   single handwritten strokes — slanted, letters run together, smoothed through
   their points — with its own flourish (a swoosh with an arrow, a star, a
   crown, drips, a heart), then rasterised once into a small mask that the wall
   painters read from.
   ================================================================ */
var TAG_G = {   /* single-stroke letters. y: 0 cap top, 0.45 x-height, 1 baseline, 1.35 descender */
  P:[[[0,1],[0,0],[0.4,0],[0.55,0.12],[0.55,0.33],[0.4,0.45],[0,0.45]]],
  L:[[[0.02,0],[0,1],[0.5,0.98]]],
  U:[[[0,0],[0,0.75],[0.12,1],[0.4,1],[0.52,0.75],[0.52,0]]],
  R:[[[0,1],[0,0],[0.4,0],[0.55,0.12],[0.55,0.33],[0.4,0.45],[0,0.45]], [[0.22,0.45],[0.58,1.02]]],
  F:[[[0.6,0],[0,0.02],[0,1]], [[0,0.46],[0.42,0.44]]],
  S:[[[0.52,0.1],[0.35,0],[0.12,0.02],[0.02,0.2],[0.15,0.42],[0.4,0.55],[0.52,0.78],[0.4,0.98],[0.15,1],[0,0.88]]],
  s:[[[0.36,0.5],[0.22,0.45],[0.06,0.5],[0.06,0.64],[0.3,0.74],[0.38,0.88],[0.28,1],[0.04,0.96]]],
  k:[[[0,0],[0,1]], [[0.38,0.45],[0.04,0.72],[0.4,1]]],
  y:[[[0,0.45],[0.18,0.92]], [[0.42,0.45],[0.14,1.35],[-0.02,1.28]]],
  a:[[[0.4,0.55],[0.25,0.45],[0.06,0.55],[0.02,0.85],[0.15,1],[0.35,0.9],[0.4,0.6],[0.4,0.45],[0.42,0.95],[0.52,1]]],
  i:[[[0.06,0.5],[0.06,1]], [[0.05,0.26],[0.08,0.3]]],
  n:[[[0,1],[0,0.45],[0,0.6],[0.15,0.46],[0.32,0.46],[0.4,0.6],[0.4,1]]],
  t:[[[0.14,0.08],[0.14,0.9],[0.24,1],[0.36,0.95]], [[0,0.45],[0.32,0.43]]],
  u:[[[0,0.45],[0,0.85],[0.12,1],[0.3,0.95],[0.4,0.8],[0.4,0.45],[0.42,1]]],
  b:[[[0,0],[0,1],[0,0.7],[0.15,0.5],[0.32,0.5],[0.42,0.7],[0.36,0.92],[0.18,1],[0,0.95]]]
};
var TAG_W = { P:0.58, L:0.52, U:0.55, R:0.6, F:0.52, S:0.55, s:0.4, k:0.42, y:0.45, a:0.52, i:0.12, n:0.44, t:0.36, u:0.46, b:0.44 };
/* style: w stroke width (px at mask scale), skew, gap (letter spacing), and extras */
var TAG_DEFS = {
  sky:   { w:5,  skew:0.32, gap:-0.04, swoosh:true, star:true, seed:3 },
  PLUR:  { w:6,  skew:0.18, gap:0.02,  heart:true, seed:7 },
  Rain:  { w:15, skew:0.22, gap:-0.02, throwie:true, drips:true, seed:11 },
  Faint: { w:6,  skew:0.36, gap:-0.06, swoosh:true, star:true, seed:13 },
  Sin:   { w:9,  skew:0.26, gap:0.0,   drips:true, seed:17 },
  Faust: { w:5,  skew:0.3,  gap:-0.03, underline2:true, seed:19 },
  tabb:  { w:5,  skew:0.24, gap:-0.05, crown:true, seed:23 }
};
var TAGS = {};
(function(){
  var MW_ = 320, MH_ = 120, CH = 58, BASE = 88;
  function rng(seed){ var s = seed*9301 + 49297; return function(){ s = (s*9301 + 49297) % 233280; return s/233280; }; }
  Object.keys(TAG_DEFS).forEach(function(word){
    var D = TAG_DEFS[word], cv = document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width = MW_; cv.height = MH_;
    var g = cv.getContext('2d'), R = rng(D.seed);
    g.lineCap = 'round'; g.lineJoin = 'round'; g.strokeStyle = '#fff'; g.fillStyle = '#fff';
    /* lay the word out, then scale it to fit the mask */
    var total = 0; for (var c = 0; c < word.length; c++) total += TAG_W[word[c]] + D.gap;
    var sc = Math.min(CH, (MW_ - 60)/total), x0 = 24, strokes = [], lows = [];
    for (var c2 = 0; c2 < word.length; c2++) {
      var ch = word[c2], lift = (R() - 0.5)*6, size = sc*(0.92 + R()*0.16);
      TAG_G[ch].forEach(function(st){
        strokes.push(st.map(function(p){
          var yy = BASE - size + p[1]*size + lift;
          return [x0 + p[0]*size + D.skew*(BASE - yy) + (R() - 0.5)*2.2, yy + (R() - 0.5)*2.2];
        }));
      });
      lows.push([x0 + TAG_W[ch]*size*0.5, BASE + lift]);
      x0 += (TAG_W[ch] + D.gap)*sc;
    }
    function path(pts){
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(pts[0][0], pts[0][1]);
      if (pts.length === 2) { g.lineTo(pts[1][0], pts[1][1]); return; }
      for (var k = 1; k < pts.length - 1; k++) { var mx = (pts[k][0] + pts[k + 1][0])/2, my = (pts[k][1] + pts[k + 1][1])/2; g.quadraticCurveTo(pts[k][0], pts[k][1], mx, my); }
      g.lineTo(pts[pts.length - 1][0], pts[pts.length - 1][1]);
    }
    function drawAll(w){ g.lineWidth = w; strokes.forEach(function(st){ path(st); g.stroke(); }); }
    drawAll(D.w);
    if (D.throwie) {   /* bubble letters: thick outline, hollow middle */
      g.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-out'; drawAll(D.w*0.45); g.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-over';
    }
    g.lineWidth = Math.max(2.5, D.w*0.55);
    var endX = x0 + 6;
    if (D.swoosh) {   /* underline swoosh with an arrow */
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(18, BASE + 14); g.quadraticCurveTo((18 + endX)/2, BASE + 26, endX + 10, BASE - 8); g.stroke();
      g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(endX + 10, BASE - 8); g.lineTo(endX - 4, BASE - 6); g.moveTo(endX + 10, BASE - 8); g.lineTo(endX + 6, BASE + 6); g.stroke();
    }
    if (D.underline2) { for (var q = 0; q < 2; q++) { g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(20, BASE + 10 + q*7); g.lineTo(endX, BASE + 6 + q*7); g.stroke(); } }
    function star(cx, cy, r){ g.beginPath(); for (var k = 0; k < 10; k++) { var a = -Math.PI/2 + k*Math.PI/5, rr = k & 1 ? r*0.42 : r; g.lineTo(cx + Math.cos(a)*rr, cy + Math.sin(a)*rr); } g.closePath(); g.fill(); }
    if (D.star) star(endX + 4, BASE - CH - 2, 9);
    if (D.crown) { g.beginPath(); var cx0 = 30, cy0 = BASE - CH - 6; g.moveTo(cx0, cy0 + 12); g.lineTo(cx0 + 2, cy0); g.lineTo(cx0 + 9, cy0 + 7); g.lineTo(cx0 + 15, cy0 - 3); g.lineTo(cx0 + 21, cy0 + 7); g.lineTo(cx0 + 28, cy0); g.lineTo(cx0 + 30, cy0 + 12); g.closePath(); g.stroke(); }
    if (D.heart) { var hx = endX + 6, hy = BASE - 22; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(hx, hy + 12); g.bezierCurveTo(hx - 16, hy, hx - 8, hy - 12, hx, hy - 3); g.bezierCurveTo(hx + 8, hy - 12, hx + 16, hy, hx, hy + 12); g.fill(); }
    if (D.drips) { g.lineWidth = 2.5; lows.forEach(function(p, k){ if (R() < 0.7) { var len = 8 + R()*22; g.beginPath(); g.moveTo(p[0] + (R() - 0.5)*10, p[1] - 2); g.lineTo(p[0] + (R() - 0.5)*10, p[1] + len); g.stroke(); } }); }
    var id = g.getImageData(0, 0, MW_, MH_).data, m = new Uint8Array(MW_*MH_);
    for (var i = 0; i < MW_*MH_; i++) m[i] = id[i*4 + 3];
    TAGS[word] = { w:MW_, h:MH_, m:m };
  });
})();
/* is (a, b) — 0..1 across and down the tag's box — on the tag? */
function tagAt(word, a, b){
  var T = TAGS[word]; if (!T || a < 0 || a >= 1 || b < 0 || b >= 1) return 0;
  return T.m[((b*T.h) | 0)*T.w + ((a*T.w) | 0)]/255;
}
/* a tag laid on a wall: s across (world units), h up; box from (s0, top) w wide.
   the mask is 320x120, so the box is w x w*0.375 */
function tagOn(word, s, h, s0, top, w){ return tagAt(word, (s - s0)/w, (top - h)/(w*0.375)); }

function faintAt(a, b){
  if (a < 0 || a >= 1 || b < 0 || b >= 1) return 0;
  return FAINT_SCAN.m[((b*FAINT_SCAN.h) | 0)*FAINT_SCAN.w + ((a*FAINT_SCAN.w) | 0)];
}
/* on the machine's side, low down: pink-plum marker with a dark outline and a
   bit of gloss down each stroke, like the drawing. box 0.24 wide from 0.03 in,
   its top at 0.5 up. */
function vendTag(e, h, flip){
  if (flip) return -1;
  var sw = e*(VBOXM.y1 - VBOXM.y0), W = 0.235, H = W*204/360, a = (sw - 0.03)/W, b = (0.5 - h)/H;
  var PXQ = 110, a = (Math.floor(a*PXQ) + 0.5)/PXQ, b = (Math.floor(b*PXQ*0.567) + 0.5)/(PXQ*0.567);   /* chunkier, like it was drawn in the room's own pixels */
  var f = faintAt(a, b);
  if (f === 2) {
    var up = faintAt(a, b - 0.03), gl = up === 2 && faintAt(a - 0.012, b) === 2 && faintAt(a + 0.012, b) === 2;
    return PK(R_HEART, clamp(0.56 + (gl ? 0.1 : -0.05) + (vn(a*60, b*60) - 0.5)*0.08, 0, 1), 0);
  }
  if (f === 1) return PK(R_BLACK, 0.1, 0);
  return -1;
}

/* ---- 2. the clippings taped to the vending machine's side (Oct 25, redone: real newsprint) ----
   cheap grey-cream paper gone yellow at the edges, cut a little crooked with scissors (one torn), the ink not quite black
   and a little soft, set in narrow justified columns with a column rule; the grain of the paper over everything; a
   halftone photo. every line is fitted to its width so no font, on any computer, runs over the edge. */
function f3Cut(x, y, w, h, seed, torn){   /* a clipping's outline: scissor-cut, a little crooked; torn along one side if asked */
  var p = [], n = 9, i, j;
  for (i = 0; i <= n; i++) p.push([x + w*i/n, y + (hsh(i, seed) - 0.5)*2.2]);
  for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) p.push([x + w + (hsh(i, seed + 1) - 0.5)*2.2, y + h*i/n]);
  for (i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) { var ty = y + h; if (torn === 'b') { ty += (hsh(i*3, seed + 2) - 0.5)*9; p.push([x + w*(i + 0.5)/n, y + h + (hsh(i*3 + 1, seed + 2) - 0.5)*7]); } p.push([x + w*i/n, ty + (torn === 'b' ? 0 : (hsh(i, seed + 3) - 0.5)*2.2)]); }
  for (j = n - 1; j > 0; j--) p.push([x + (hsh(j, seed + 4) - 0.5)*2.2, y + h*j/n]);
  return '<path d="M' + p.map(function(q){ return q[0].toFixed(1) + ',' + q[1].toFixed(1); }).join(' L') + ' Z"';
}
function f3Newsprint(id, x, y, w, h, seed, torn, tone){   /* the paper itself: the cut, the yellowing, the grain (clipped to the cut) */
  var cut = f3Cut(x, y, w, h, seed, torn);
  return '<clipPath id="' + id + '">' + cut + '/></clipPath>' + cut + ' fill="' + (tone || '#d6ceb6') + '"/>' +
    '<g clip-path="url(#' + id + ')"><rect x="' + x + '" y="' + y + '" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '" fill="url(#f3yel)"/><rect x="' + (x - 5) + '" y="' + (y - 5) + '" width="' + (w + 10) + '" height="' + (h + 10) + '" filter="url(#f3grain)" opacity="0.32"/></g>';
}

SND.el = document.createElement('button');   /* (never shown) */
sndStep = function(){};
var _egSndBuild = sndBuild;

var _egOneShot = sndOneShot;
sndOneShot = function(k){ var r = _egOneShot.apply(null, arguments); try { if (CC_TEXT[k]) EG_SEAM.cc(k, CC_TEXT[k]); } catch (e) {} return r; };
EG_SEAM.soundOn = function(heard, cc){
  SND.on = !!(heard || cc);
  if (SND.on) { try { if (!SND.ctx) sndBuild(); SND.ctx.resume(); SND.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(heard ? SND_VOL : 0, SND.ctx.currentTime, 0.05); } catch (e) {} }
  else if (SND.ctx) SND.master.gain.setTargetAtTime(0, SND.ctx.currentTime, 0.05);
};
/* ---- (Nov 19) EMBROIDERY'S LOOK FOR EVERYTHING IN THE POCKET. Aisling: "we need to keep stuff but make it look real
   and cool in embriodery". Every thing keeps its id, words and drawing (Seam's, the masters); only how it's drawn
   changes here, and only on Embroidery pages. Seam's own files are untouched.
   - Seam snaps a thing's drawing to the station's inks, pixel by pixel. Here the drawing stays smooth, and the inks
     only grade it (a quarter of each pixel's colour comes from its ink), so the palette holds.
   - Each part takes a material from its ink: silver, gold, brass and metal shine; rusted metal is rough; paper and
     cream get a fine fibre; glowing inks stay lit; everything else is a soft matte. Raised lines catch a light from
     the top left, edges darken a touch, and a barely-there grain sits over it all (real but unreal).
   - Foil (the passport, the pass, the moon water) gets a slow holographic band: silver, lavender, teal-grey, amber,
     with the slight blue lustre Aisling allowed for the holograms (Nov 17).
   - Stamps get real ink: ragged edges, uneven pressure, little gaps where the ink missed. Text stays readable.
   Anything without a drawing yet falls back to Seam's own way, so nothing is ever missing. ---- */
var EG_MAT = {}; RNAMES.forEach(function(n, i){ EG_MAT[i] = /^(silver|gold|metal|brass|hgold|hgilt|phone)$/.test(n) ? 1 : n === 'rustm' ? 4 : /^(paper|pwhite|hcream|bCream|plasterV|mintw)$/.test(n) ? 2 : /^(glowc|glowa|neon|pneon|plumglow|nullblue|hglrose|hglgreen|hglgold)$/.test(n) ? 3 : 0; });
function egNoise(i, j){ var n = Math.sin(i*12.9898 + j*78.233)*43758.5453; return n - Math.floor(n); }
/* ---- (Nov 20, Aisling: "the 3d things are too cartoon and stark … more konami or horror game or like sh3 … the same
   object design but not seam looks … less cartoon and outlined, more real hazy missing mile") the real pass, over every
   thing in the pocket: the drawing's hard edges softened (a blur mixed in, so words still read), colour muted and the
   blacks lifted like old film, a little of Missing Mile's fog over it, then the wear a real thing carries: soft grime
   gathering in patches and at the edges, fine creases, scuffs, and grain. ---- */
function egVN(x, y){ var xi = Math.floor(x), yi = Math.floor(y), fx = x - xi, fy = y - yi; fx = fx*fx*(3 - 2*fx); fy = fy*fy*(3 - 2*fy);
  var a = egNoise(xi, yi), b = egNoise(xi + 1, yi), c = egNoise(xi, yi + 1), e = egNoise(xi + 1, yi + 1); return a + (b - a)*fx + (c - a)*fy + (a - b - c + e)*fx*fy; }
function egReal(d, w, h, S){
  var n = w*h, R = Math.max(1, Math.round(S*1.4)), src = new Float32Array(n*4), tmp = new Float32Array(n*4), k, i, j, c;
  for (k = 0; k < n*4; k++) src[k] = d[k];
  /* a soft copy: box blur across then down (alpha-weighted, so edges don't pick up black) */
  var pass = function(from, to, dx, dy){ for (j = 0; j < h; j++) for (i = 0; i < w; i++) { var sr = 0, sg = 0, sb = 0, sa = 0, cnt = 0;
      for (var t = -R; t <= R; t++) { var xx = i + t*dx, yy = j + t*dy; if (xx < 0 || yy < 0 || xx >= w || yy >= h) continue; var q = (yy*w + xx)*4, al = from[q + 3]; sr += from[q]*al; sg += from[q + 1]*al; sb += from[q + 2]*al; sa += al; cnt++; }
      var o = (j*w + i)*4; if (sa > 0) { to[o] = sr/sa; to[o + 1] = sg/sa; to[o + 2] = sb/sa; } to[o + 3] = sa/cnt; } };
  pass(src, tmp, 1, 0); var soft = new Float32Array(n*4); pass(tmp, soft, 0, 1);
  var FOG = [138, 128, 118], sx = 1/(18*S), sc = 1/(5*S);
  for (j = 0; j < h; j++) for (i = 0; i < w; i++) { k = j*w + i; var o = k*4; if (src[o + 3] < 6 && soft[o + 3] < 6) { d[o + 3] = 0; continue; }
    var r = src[o]*0.62 + soft[o]*0.38, g = src[o + 1]*0.62 + soft[o + 1]*0.38, b = src[o + 2]*0.62 + soft[o + 2]*0.38;
    var L = r*0.3 + g*0.59 + b*0.11; r = L + (r - L)*0.68; g = L + (g - L)*0.68; b = L + (b - L)*0.68;   /* muted */
    r = 22 + r*0.8; g = 20 + g*0.79; b = 18 + b*0.76;   /* blacks lifted, highlights pulled down, a little warm */
    var gr = egVN(i*sx, j*sx)*0.6 + egVN(i*sx*2.3 + 7, j*sx*2.3)*0.4, grime = Math.max(0, gr - 0.48)*0.55;   /* soft patches of dirt */
    var crease = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(egVN(i*sc*0.6, j*sc*3 + 11) - 0.5)*40)*0.08 + Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(egVN(i*sc*3 + 5, j*sc*0.6) - 0.5)*40)*0.06;   /* fine creases */
    var ea = 0; for (c = 1; c <= 3; c++) { var dd = c*S*2; if ((i < dd || src[((j)*w + Math.max(0, i - dd))*4 + 3] < 40) || (i >= w - dd || src[(j*w + Math.min(w - 1, i + dd))*4 + 3] < 40) || (j < dd || src[(Math.max(0, j - dd)*w + i)*4 + 3] < 40) || (j >= h - dd || src[(Math.min(h - 1, j + dd)*w + i)*4 + 3] < 40)) { ea = (4 - c)/3; break; } }   /* worn at the edges */
    var scuff = egNoise((i/(2*S)) | 0, (j/(2*S)) | 0) > 0.985 ? 0.18 : 0, grain = (egNoise(i*3 + 1, j*7 + 2) - 0.5)*14;
    var dark = 1 - grime*0.5 - ea*0.14 - crease*0.5, lite = ea*10 + crease*30 + scuff*60;
    r = r*dark + lite*0.95 + grain; g = g*dark + lite*0.9 + grain; b = b*dark + lite*0.82 + grain;
    r = r*0.9 + FOG[0]*0.1; g = g*0.9 + FOG[1]*0.1; b = b*0.9 + FOG[2]*0.1;   /* Missing Mile's haze */
    d[o] = r < 0 ? 0 : r > 255 ? 255 : r; d[o + 1] = g < 0 ? 0 : g > 255 ? 255 : g; d[o + 2] = b < 0 ? 0 : b > 255 ? 255 : b;
    d[o + 3] = Math.max(src[o + 3]*0.85 + soft[o + 3]*0.15, 0); }
}
function egBake(M, img, S, A){
  var INK = (A && A.ink) || (A && A.loud ? pkInkL : (A && A.green ? pkInkG : pkInk));
  var w = M.w*S, h = M.h*S, c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = w; c.height = h;
  var x = c.getContext('2d'); x.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; x.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high'; x.drawImage(img, 0, 0, w, h);
  var id = x.getImageData(0, 0, w, h), d = id.data, L = new Float32Array(w*h), A = new Uint8Array(w*h);
  for (var k = 0; k < w*h; k++) { L[k] = (d[k*4]*0.3 + d[k*4 + 1]*0.59 + d[k*4 + 2]*0.11)/255; A[k] = d[k*4 + 3]; }
  var fm = document.createElement('canvas'); fm.width = w; fm.height = h; var fx = fm.getContext('2d'), fid = fx.createImageData(w, h), fd = fid.data, anyFoil = false;
  for (var j = 0; j < h; j++) for (var i = 0; i < w; i++) {
    var k = j*w + i; if (A[k] < 8) continue;
    var r = d[k*4], g = d[k*4 + 1], b = d[k*4 + 2], q = INK(r, g, b), ri = q ? q[0] : -1, mt = ri >= 0 ? EG_MAT[ri] : 0;   /* (the inks read from this drawing itself, not Seam's, so a fixed drawing leaves no ghost) */
    if (ri >= 0) { var nR = RN[ri], ix = Math.min(nR - 1, Math.max(0, (q[1]*(nR - 1)) | 0)), ic = RF[ri*FOGN*RMAX + ix];   /* the ink grades it */
      r = r*0.75 + (ic & 255)*0.25; g = g*0.75 + ((ic >> 8) & 255)*0.25; b = b*0.75 + ((ic >> 16) & 255)*0.25; }
    if (mt === 3) { d[k*4] = r; d[k*4 + 1] = g; d[k*4 + 2] = b; continue; }   /* glowing: left lit */
    var lx = i > 0 ? L[k - 1] : L[k], rx = i < w - 1 ? L[k + 1] : L[k], uy = j > 0 ? L[k - w] : L[k], dy = j < h - 1 ? L[k + w] : L[k];
    var relief = ((lx - rx) + (uy - dy))*0.7;   /* raised lines catch the light from the top left */
    var edge = 0; if ((i > 1 && A[k - 2] < 60) || (i < w - 2 && A[k + 2] < 60) || (j > 1 && A[k - 2*w] < 60) || (j < h - 2 && A[k + 2*w] < 60)) edge = 1;
    var shade = 1 + 0.07*(0.5 - (i/w + j/h)/2)*2 - 0.03*edge, add = 0, grain = (egNoise(i, j) - 0.5)*0.035;
    if (mt === 1) { var band = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs((i/w)*0.8 + (j/h)*0.6 - 0.55)*4.5); add = 70*relief + 38*band*band + 18*relief*relief*9; shade *= 0.92 + 0.1*L[k]; }
    else if (mt === 4) { add = 30*relief; grain *= 3; }
    else if (mt === 2) { add = 22*relief; grain += (egNoise((i/3) | 0, j) - 0.5)*0.03 + (egNoise(i, (j/5) | 0) - 0.5)*0.02; }   /* paper fibre */
    else { add = 40*relief; }
    var f = shade*(1 + grain);
    d[k*4] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, r*f + add)); d[k*4 + 1] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, g*f + add*0.96)); d[k*4 + 2] = Math.max(0, Math.min(255, b*f + add*0.9));
    if (ri === R_SILVER || ri === R_GOLD || ri === R_PLUMGLOW) { fd[k*4 + 3] = A[k]; anyFoil = true; }
  }
  egReal(d, w, h, S);   /* (Nov 20) the real, hazy pass */
  x.putImageData(id, 0, 0); if (anyFoil) fx.putImageData(fid, 0, 0);
  return { c:c, foil:anyFoil ? fm : null };
}
/* ---- (Nov 19, later) EMBROIDERY'S FIXES TO THE DRAWINGS. Aisling: "some things arent connected or are not quite like
   right … the top is a little weird". Seam's pixels hid small faults that the smooth look shows. These change only how
   a thing is drawn in Embroidery; its id and words are Seam's, untouched.
   - Words go on top: a word drawn before a picture that then covered it (Apple on its carton, watermelon, the candy
     names under their fruit) is moved to the end of its own group, so it sits over the picture; where it was covered,
     it gets a faint edge in the opposite tone so it reads.
   - Cans get a real top: the shoulder narrows into a neck, a rolled rim, the lid sunk inside it, the tab lying on the lid.
   - Ink bottles get a neck between the glass and the cap; the cap is ribbed, not a black block.
   - The wind bells' wishes are written down the paper strip, as on a real 風鈴 (they ran off it sideways).
   - The onigiri's tear line stays on the wrapper. ---- */
var EG_CANTOP = function(x0, x1, y){   /* a can's top, its body from x0 to x1, the body starting at y */

function egFixDom(id, root){   /* words on top; the wind bells' wishes down their strips */
  var ts = root.querySelectorAll('text');
  for (var i = 0; i < ts.length; i++) {
    var t = ts[i], par = t.parentNode, after = false;
    for (var n = t.nextSibling; n; n = n.nextSibling) if (n.nodeType === 1 && n.tagName !== 'text' && n.tagName !== 'defs') { after = true; break; }
    if (!after) continue;
    par.appendChild(t);
    var f = (t.getAttribute('fill') || (t.style && t.style.fill) || '#000').trim(), m = f.match(/^#([0-9a-f]{6})$/i), lum = 0;
    if (m) { var v = parseInt(m[1], 16); lum = (((v >> 16) & 255)*0.3 + ((v >> 8) & 255)*0.59 + (v & 255)*0.11)/255; }
    var fs = parseFloat((t.style && t.style.fontSize) || t.getAttribute('font-size') || '3') || 3;
    t.setAttribute('stroke', lum > 0.5 ? '#000000' : '#ffffff'); t.setAttribute('stroke-opacity', '0.35'); t.setAttribute('stroke-width', (fs*0.14).toFixed(2)); t.setAttribute('paint-order', 'stroke'); t.setAttribute('stroke-linejoin', 'round');
  }
  var T = function(fn){ var a = root.querySelectorAll('text'); for (var k = 0; k < a.length; k++) fn(a[k], a[k].textContent || ''); };
  var gsz = function(t){ return parseFloat((t.style && t.style.fontSize) || t.getAttribute('font-size') || '3') || 3; }, ssz = function(t, v){ t.setAttribute('font-size', v.toFixed(2)); if (t.style) t.style.fontSize = v.toFixed(2) + 'px'; };
  var fit = function(t, maxW){ var len = (t.textContent || '').length, sz = gsz(t), cjk = /[\u3000-\u9fff]/.test(t.textContent || ''), w = len*sz*(cjk ? 1 : 0.58); if (w > maxW) ssz(t, sz*maxW/w); };
  var html = root.outerHTML || '';
  if (/^f_carton_/.test(id)) T(function(t){ if (t.getAttribute('y') === '28') { t.setAttribute('y', '22.8'); fit(t, 22); } });   /* the carton's name above its picture, not on it */
  if (html.indexOf('M3 6 L37 6 Q39 28 37 49 L3 49 Q1 28 3 6 Z') >= 0) T(function(t){ if (t.getAttribute('y') === '43') t.setAttribute('y', '46.6'); if (t.getAttribute('y') === '20') fit(t, 33); });   /* pillow bags: the small name below the picture; the big one inside the bag */
  if (id === 'f_cam_torundesu' || id === 'f_cam_flash') T(function(t){ if (t.getAttribute('y') === '26') { t.setAttribute('x', '30.5'); fit(t, 20); } });   /* the small words kept on the camera */
  if (id === 'f_album') T(function(t, c){ if (c === 'アルバム') fit(t, 24); });
  if (id === 'f_waxbottles') { var g = root.ownerDocument.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg', 'g'); g.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(22 15) scale(0.92) translate(-25 -15.5)'); while (root.firstChild) g.appendChild(root.firstChild); root.appendChild(g); }   /* all five bottles inside the picture */
  if (id === 'f_gematogen') T(function(t, c){ if (c === 'ГЕМАТОГЕН') { t.setAttribute('x', '26.5'); fit(t, 30); } });
  if (id === 'f_taffy') { var el = root.querySelectorAll('ellipse'); for (var k = 0; k < el.length; k++) { var cy = el[k].getAttribute('cy'); if (cy === '18') el[k].setAttribute('cy', '20.3'); if (cy === '5') el[k].setAttribute('cy', '4.6'); } }
  if (id === 'f_stolichnye') { var pth = root.querySelectorAll('path'); for (var k = 0; k < pth.length; k++) { var d = pth[k].getAttribute('d') || ''; if (/^M18,30|^M13,20/.test(d)) pth[k].setAttribute('transform', 'translate(20 3) scale(0.84) translate(-20 -3)'); } T(function(t){ fit(t, 14); }); }
  if (id === 'f_shirousagi') T(function(t){ if (+t.getAttribute('y') > 45) t.setAttribute('y', '44'); });
  if (id === 'f_mag_shojo') T(function(t, c){ if (/^ribbon moon/.test(c)) { t.setAttribute('x', '15'); ssz(t, 1.8); } });
  if (/^f_furin/.test(id)) { var all = root.querySelectorAll('text'); for (var k = 1; k < all.length; k++) all[k].parentNode.removeChild(all[k]); }
  if (/^f_furin/.test(id)) { var w = root.querySelector('text'); if (w) { var len = (w.textContent || '').replace(/\s/g, '').length || 1, sz = Math.min(2.8, 33/len);
    w.setAttribute('x', '20'); w.setAttribute('y', '36'); w.setAttribute('writing-mode', 'tb'); w.setAttribute('style', (w.getAttribute('style') || '').replace(/font-size:[^;]*;?/, '') + ';writing-mode:vertical-rl;text-orientation:upright;font-size:' + sz.toFixed(2) + 'px'); w.setAttribute('font-size', sz.toFixed(2)); w.setAttribute('text-anchor', 'start'); w.removeAttribute('stroke'); } }

function egSvgFor(id, A, w, h){
  var raw = '<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 ' + A.vb[0] + ' ' + A.vb[1] + '" width="' + w + '" height="' + h + '">' + egFixSvg(id, EG_ART[id] ? EG_ART[id]() : A.svg()) + '</svg>';
  try { var doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(raw, 'image/svg+xml'); if (!doc.querySelector('parsererror')) { egFixDom(id, doc.documentElement); raw = new XMLSerializer().serializeToString(doc.documentElement); } } catch (e) {}
  return raw;
}
var _egPkMap = pkMap;
pkMap = function(id, done){
  _egPkMap(id, function(){
    var A = PK_ART[id], M = POK.maps[id]; if (!M) { done(); return; }
    var S = Math.max(1, Math.min(3, Math.floor(900/Math.max(M.w, M.h)))), img = new Image();   /* drawn finer than its lifted size, so it stays sharp up close */
    if (A && A.paint) { try { var pc = document.createElement('canvas'); pc.width = M.w*S; pc.height = M.h*S; A.paint(pc.getContext('2d'), pc.width, pc.height); M.eg = egBake(M, pc, S, A); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } done(); return; }   /* (a thing painted straight onto a canvas: the stranger's note) */
    if (!A || typeof A.svg !== 'function') { done(); return; }   /* (nothing to draw it from: Seam's own way) */
    img.onload = function(){ try { M.eg = egBake(M, img, S, A); } catch (e) { console.error(e); } done(); };
    img.onerror = function(){ done(); };
    img.src = 'data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,' + encodeURIComponent(egSvgFor(id, A, M.w*S, M.h*S));
  });
};
var _egPkSprite = pkSprite;
pkSprite = function(id, sc, rot, light, now){
  var M = POK.maps[id], A = PK_ART[id]; if (!M || !M.eg || EG_SEAM.lookOff) return _egPkSprite.apply(null, arguments);
  var cs = Math.cos(rot), sn = Math.sin(rot), hw = M.w*sc/2, hh = M.h*sc/2;
  var W = Math.ceil(Math.abs(hw*cs) + Math.abs(hh*sn))*2 + 2, H = Math.ceil(Math.abs(hw*sn) + Math.abs(hh*cs))*2 + 2;
  var c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = W; c.height = H; var x = c.getContext('2d');
  x.imageSmoothingEnabled = true; x.imageSmoothingQuality = 'high';
  x.save(); x.translate(W/2, H/2); x.rotate(rot); x.drawImage(M.eg.c, -hw, -hh, hw*2, hh*2); x.restore();
  if (A.foil && now && M.eg.foil) {   /* the hologram: a slow band of colour sliding across the foil */
    var t = document.createElement('canvas'); t.width = W; t.height = H; var tx = t.getContext('2d'), ph = ((now/1000)*0.11) % 1, gr = tx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, W, H);
    [[0, 'rgba(200,200,205,0)'], [0.2, 'rgba(200,200,205,0.5)'], [0.4, 'rgba(156,143,184,0.6)'], [0.55, 'rgba(140,160,196,0.45)'], [0.7, 'rgba(127,166,160,0.55)'], [0.85, 'rgba(201,168,106,0.55)'], [1, 'rgba(201,168,106,0)']].forEach(function(s){ gr.addColorStop(s[0], s[1]); });
    tx.save(); tx.translate((ph*2 - 1)*W*1.2, (ph*2 - 1)*H*0.6); tx.fillStyle = gr; tx.fillRect(-W, -H, W*3, H*3); tx.restore();
    tx.globalCompositeOperation = 'destination-in'; tx.save(); tx.translate(W/2, H/2); tx.rotate(rot); tx.drawImage(M.eg.foil, -hw, -hh, hw*2, hh*2); tx.restore();
    x.save(); x.globalCompositeOperation = 'screen'; x.globalAlpha = 0.55; x.drawImage(t, 0, 0); x.restore();
  }
  if (light < 0.999) { x.save(); x.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop'; x.fillStyle = 'rgba(6,5,5,' + Math.min(1, 1 - light).toFixed(3) + ')'; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); x.restore(); }
  else if (light > 1.001) { x.save(); x.globalCompositeOperation = 'source-atop'; x.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,244,228,' + Math.min(0.5, (light - 1)*0.6).toFixed(3) + ')'; x.fillRect(0, 0, W, H); x.restore(); }
  var dd = x.getImageData(0, 0, W, H).data, mask = new Uint8Array(W*H); for (var q = 0; q < W*H; q++) mask[q] = dd[q*4 + 3] > 120 ? 1 : 0;
  return { c:c, W:W, H:H, mask:mask };
};
